title: The Assassination Of Ning Chi Tz - Information From Lu Ying Re Alleged Murders

page_data.en:

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ____
S.2 Special Branch
REPORT
Date July 30 1938.
（印：CONFIDENTIAL）

Subject (in full) Information from Lu Ying re alleged murderers

Made by ____ and ____ Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao Liang

At 3 p.m. July 29, Pao Tsz Ying(鲍子英), Deputy
Chief Detective of the Police Bureau of the Shanghai Municipal
Administration, called at this office on the unofficial
instructions of Lu Ying, the Chief of Police, and offered the
following information.

Several members of a gang of Kompo robbers recently
arrested by Chinese Detective Inspectors Chow Kwei Sung and
Zau Ching Van of Pootoo Road Station are alleged to have been
concerned in the murder of Yin Pao An(任保安) in the Dong
Shing Ler Restaurant, Foochow Road, on June 18, As the informa-
tion appeared to be vague, I advised Pao to return with the
necessary evidence so that I can pass the information to the
section handling these cases.

（左侧批注及印章）：
DEPUTY COMMISSIONER
TO JULY 1938
(CRIME BRANCH)

日期：1938年7月30日。
（印：机密）

主题（全称）：关于据称谋杀案凶手的情报，来源为卢英

由 ____ 和 ____ 制作，由谭绍良警司转呈

7月29日下午3时，上海市公安局副局长鲍子英奉警察局局长卢英的非正式指示，来到本办公室，并提供以下情报。

据称，近期由普陀路捕房中国探长周贵松（Chow Kwei Sung）和邹庆云（Zau Ching Van）逮捕的一伙江洋大盗成员，涉嫌参与6月18日在福州路东兴楼餐厅发生的任保安（Yin Pao An）谋杀案。由于该情报显得模糊不清，我建议鲍子英带回必要证据，以便我将此情报移交给处理此类案件的部门。

（左侧批注及印章）：
副警务总监
至1938年7月

attempted

1938年6月19日下午2时，市警务处在法租界陶尔斐司路（Rue Tenant de la Tour）411弄福兴里（福兴里）17号（嫌疑人赵树森（Zau Ts Sung 赵树森）的住所，该嫌疑人涉嫌参与1938年6月18日晚9时50分发生在福州路435号（老闸）同兴老（同兴楼）餐厅的枪击事件）搜获的文献清单。

1) 一本包含有关西安事变（1936年）通电解码电文的书籍。（似乎是从报纸上抄录的。）

2) 两本油印小册子，包含包括苏联共产党在内的几个外国政党的组织一般原则。

3) 一本中文练习簿，包含几份通常性质的官方文件样本抄件。

4) 一本小练习簿，包含官方文件中使用的几种惯用表达方式的示例。

5) 一个便笺簿，其中一页写有一份政府命令的抄件，授予已故赵光（Chao Kwung）将军身后荣誉。便笺簿中还发现了一张关于鼻病的剪报。

6) 一本练习簿，包含各种性质的报纸剪报。

7) 一本练习簿，包含关于“反动政党”和中国历史的讲座粗略笔记。

8) 一本练习簿，包含1938年6月12日至6月15日的日记，表达了作者提高其中文和英文水平的决心，并记录了他从报纸上阅读的报道主题。

9) N. 克鲁普斯卡娅所著《列宁回忆录》一书的中文译本。一本。

10) 一本练习簿，包含以下内容：

简要记述了作者于1937年7月治疗鼻病的情况。

一篇关于上海生活状况的短文。作者指出，由于武装抢劫、炸弹暴行和其他事件频发，人们在街上随时可能陷入危险。
未遂
关于姚觉松（Yiu Chueh-sung）谋杀案的报纸文章抄件（6月10日《大美晚报》）。

俞达庸（Yu Dah Yoong）遇刺未遂案。
（摘自6月11日《大美晚报》）。

6月16日，警方与武装劫匪在大同路附近的爱多亚路（Avenue Road）发生枪战。作者表示，幸运的是没有行人受伤。

CONFIDENTIAL (2)

proceed from Shanghai to Hankow.

12) A statement of accounts entitled "The Suppression Case

Sun Sun Co. (新々公司 ) }....$0.26
Total $6.16

following notes in Chinese :-
Translation
" 8 a.m.      5 p.m.    Bund Park Ferry Service Jetty.
After 5 p.m. Bus stopping place at the corner of
Chungking and Avenue Edward VII. "

14) A visiting card:-
(In Chinese)
An Tsung Koh (安貞國 ),
135 Rue des Soeurs, French Concession.
Tel. 76843.

(In English) "I. K. Ahn."

15) A pad of chits, appearing to be receipt forms, numbered

(Written on sheet No. 145005)
Zung Liu Sz (防, 刘氏 )(name of a female), 39,
Kading. 411/17 Rue Tenant de la Tour.

(Written on sheet No. 145096)
Woo Tsung Jang (吴振强 ) alias Toong Yang Kwei
(東洋鬼 meaning Japanese devil). Tsung Kee
(蒼記 )Lodging House, behind the Great World
Amusement Resort.

16) A written report (Names of the addressor and addressee or
date, not given) stating that Zang Moo Chang, Zang Ngoh
Tsing and other traitors in Shanghai have organized the
Huang Dao and Asia Rehabilitation Societies. It further
states that, under the instructions of Zang Ngoh Tsing,
one Wong Foo Sung(王富勝 ) alias Wong Fu Zung(王輔澄 ),
native of Hupeh, ex-worker, member of the Red Pang, will
soon leave Shanghai for Hankow with a number of his
followers, all natives of Hupeh, to carry out assassinations
of important government officials; and that a Cantonese
lawyer named Yang Kwok Chu (楊國枢 ), residing in Yuen
Ming Yuen Road, are enlisting female nurses and girl students,
all natives of Kwangtung, for subversive activities among
wounded soldiers and also for espionage work at the front.

11) 一份书面报告，关于何平（Ho Ping）从警方拘留中释放（何平涉嫌参与5月28日在成都路地区发生的宗浩甫（Zung Hao Poo）谋杀案）。该报告还包含一份申请，要求借款20美元给何平，使其能够从上海前往汉口。

（写在第145096号页上）
吴振强（Woo Tsung Jang），别名东洋鬼（Toong Yang Kwei，意为日本魔鬼）。苍记（Tsung Kee）客栈，位于大世界游乐场后面。

16) 一份书面报告（未注明发件人和收件人姓名或日期），称张慕昌（Zang Moo Chang）、张鄂清（Zang Ngoh Tsing）及其他在上海的汉奸组织了黄道会和亚洲复兴社。报告进一步指出，在张鄂清的指示下，湖北籍前工人、红帮成员王富胜（Wong Foo Sung），别名王辅澄（Wong Fu Zung），将很快与其追随者（均为湖北籍）离开上海前往汉口，执行对重要政府官员的刺杀任务；并称居住在圆明园路的广东籍律师杨国枢（Yang Kwok Chu）正在招募广东籍女护士和女学生，在伤兵中进行颠覆活动，并在前线从事间谍工作。

17) An exercise book bearing the seal "鄭修文" on the
cover, containing the followings:-

Diary written in January, 1937. (Nothing of interest).

Copies of letters relating to expenses incurred in
anti-traitor service at Soochow; dates, places and

18) 21 photos of five male Chinese.

----

Addendum

Regarding an account of a treatment of nose disease
given in Exhibit No. 10 (Please see page 1 of this list),
it contains a copy of the following letter:-

"To the Chun Shan Hospital ( 中山 ), July 8th.

A member of this squad named Chao Zui Sung ( 乔樹森 )
is suffering from nose disease and intends to undergo
treatment at your hospital. Please allow him to
take up 3rd class ward and collect payment at half rate.
Please collect medical expenses from this squad.

Detective Squad of the Woosung-Shanghai
Garrison Headquarters.

(The remaining portion of the account merely deals with
the writer's experience in hospital. )

（宋修文 Sung Sieu Vung）

1937年1月的日记。（无感兴趣内容）。

有关在苏州从事反汉奸服务所产生的费用的信件抄件；日期、地点和其他重要细节均被省略。

18) 五名中国男性的照片21张。

----

附录

关于展品第10号中给出的鼻病治疗记述（请参阅本清单第1页），其中包含以下信件的抄件：

“致中山医院（Chun Shan Hospital），7月8日。

本队队员乔树森（Chao Zui Sung）患有鼻病，拟在贵院接受治疗。请允许其入住三等病房，并按半价收取费用。医疗费用请向本队收取。

淞沪警备司令部侦探队。

（账目的其余部分仅涉及作者在医院的经历。）

Ta Mei Pao publishes the following article to-day, June 21 :-

THE ASSASSINATION OF ZUNG PAO-AN

Zung Pao-an (仲保安 ), Commissioner of the
Land Bureau of the Shanghai Municipal Administration,
was assassinated at the Tung Shing Lou Restaurant
(同兴楼酒馆) on June 18.

Yesterday a letter signed by the Intelligence
Section of the Executive Department of --- organ in
Shanghai of the Third Army Headquarters was received by
this paper. According to this letter, the murder of Zung
Pao-an had nothing to do with Chinese patriotic bodies.

The following is the letter:-

"Mr. Editor,

"We write you this letter in the hope that
your paper will make an explanation for us to the public.

"We have to inform you that Zung Pao-an was
not the kind of person worth while our trouble to assassinate.
C. P. Our body deals exclusively with the killing of traitors.
Moreover, the persons who undertook his assassination
left two Mauser pistols behind. Can you imagine any one
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / 21 JUNE 1938 / SPECIAL BRANCH） discarding the weapons with which he is making a living
this time when firearms are very difficult to be
obtained? We have made enquiries from various sources
but each time we were informed that Zung Pao-an was a
mean creature whose life was not worth being exchanged
（批：B / 22 JUNE 1938 / COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE） for the two Mauser pistols.

"A report has now been received by our Intelligence
Section, which states as follows:-

仲保安遇刺案

上海特别市政府土地局局长仲保安 (Zung Pao-an) 于6月18日在同兴楼酒馆遇刺身亡。

昨日，本报收到一封署名为第三军司令部上海某机关执行部情报科的信件。据该信称，仲保安之死与中国爱国团体无关。

“编辑先生：

page_data.en:
Two Dead, Five Wounded,
In Daring Assassination
At Chinese Restaurant

Commissioner Of Land Bureau Of Pootung City
Government Is Killed With Sing-Song Girl
During Party In Foochow Road Restaurant

HAIL OF LEAD FROM GUNS OF THREE
ASSASSINS POURS INTO CROWDED ROOM

A popular Chinese restaurant was the scene last night of
a daring assassination of a political nature, when three armed
men burst into a room on the first floor of the Dong Shing Lou
Restaurant, at 435 Foochow Road, and opened fire on a dinner
party given by officials of the Great Way Government, instantly
killing one man and a woman and wounding five others, among
them one woman.

Several other guests, including two Japanese, had miracul-
ous escapes from death as a hail of lead from the guns of the
assassins poured into a room about
20 feet wide by 30 feet long in
which two tables of diners were in
the midst of their repast.

The murdered man was identified
last night as Mr. Jen Tao-ehn,
Commissioner of the Land Bureau
of the Ta Too Government. The
second victim of the slaying was
a popular Chinese sing-song girl,
known as Swon Hung or "Double
Red."

Among the five wounded men was
another official of the Reformed
Government. Two of the wounded
were detained in the Chinese Lester
Hospital last night.

Japanese Escape

Six Japanese nationals, among
them two high military officers,
left the party only a few minutes
before the shooting. The two Ja-
panese who remained were awaiting
the arrival of their motor car when
the outrage occurred, experiencing
a miraculous escape from injury.

More than 15 people were detained
in Louza Police Station last night as
police launched a vigorous investiga-
tion into the outrage, but it is not
believed, that the police have laid
their hands on the assassins.

A group of about 20 people were
guests of Mr. Jen Tao-ehn at the
Dong Shing Lou Restaurant last
night, included among the party
being eight Japanese. Five Chinese
sing-song girls were called in to
enliven the party, among the enter-
tainers being one famous Chinese
singer known as "Double Red." All
went off merrily until about 9.30
o'clock when six of the eight Japan-
ese made their departure.

Three Gunmen Burst In

After accompanying them to their
cars, several Chinese guests and Mr.
Jen returned to the tables. While
the party was in full swing, at 9.53
p.m., three gunmen burst into the
room and instantly opened fire.
More than 20 shots were fired by
the assassins, the sound of the re-
ports coming so close together that
it seemed like machine-gun fire, ac-
cording to other diners in the re-
staurant.

Mr. Jen Tao-ehn collapsed with
several bullets in his body and the
sing-song girl also died instantaneous-
ly. Amid a terrific furore, and even
while inmates of the restaurant and
passers-by in the streets were scur-
rying for cover, the three assassins
made good their escape. No one
seems to have noticed their entry
and only vague descriptions of the
men were obtained by investigators.

Police Rushed To Spot

Louza Police Station received the
alarm within a few minutes of the
shooting and at once rushed every
available man to the scene
of the outrage. The Reserve Unit
happened to be on station duty in
the district at the time and was
promptly despatched to the
restaurant.

Upon their arrival, Police found
the place in an uproar. Tables had
been overturned and quantities of
crockery broken by the guests in
their mad scramble for safety. The
murdered man and girl were lying
in pools of blood, while five others
clutched their wounds.

Emergency Ambulance

A call was quickly put through
for an emergency ambulance and the
wounded men were rushed to Lest-
er Chinese Hospital. Police closed
all exits from the restaurant and
all inmates were questioned.

High Police officials visited the
scene within a few minutes after
the arrival of the Reserve Unit,
among them Assistant Commission-
er H. D. M. Robertson. Detective
Inspector A. R. Bennett of Louza
Station was in charge of the case.

The two Japanese guests, who
were present when the shooting took
place, accompanied the police to
Louza Station. One of them is a
Buddhist monk. They gave their
names as Nagatima and Takura.

（手写批注：S/32 7/6 Like B. 20/6）

大胆暗杀致两死五伤
在中餐馆发生

浦东市政府土地局局长在福州路餐馆聚会期间
与歌女一同遇害

三名刺客枪口喷出的弹雨倾泻进拥挤的房间

昨晚，一家颇受欢迎的中餐馆发生了一起具有政治性质的大胆暗杀事件，三名武装男子闯入福州路435号同兴楼酒楼一楼的一个房间，向维新政府官员举办的晚宴开火，当场打死一男一女，并打伤另外五人，其中包括一名女性。

其他几位客人，包括两名日本人，奇迹般地死里逃生，当时刺客枪口喷出的弹雨倾泻进一个宽约20英尺、长约30英尺的房间，两张餐桌上的食客正在用餐。

死者昨晚被确认为维新政府（Ta Too Government）土地局局长任道恩 (Jen Tao-ehn) 先生。另一名遇害者是一位颇受欢迎的中国歌女，名叫双红 (Swon Hung) 或“双红”。

在五名伤者中，还有另一名改组政府官员。两名伤者昨晚被留在莱斯中国医院 (Chinese Lester Hospital)。

日本人逃脱

六名日本国民，其中包括两名高级军官，在枪击发生前几分钟离开了聚会。留下的两名日本人正在等待他们的汽车到来时发生了这起暴行，奇迹般地未受伤。

昨晚，随着警方对这起暴行展开激烈调查，超过15人在老闸捕房被拘留，但人们相信警方尚未抓获刺客。

昨晚约有20人作为任道恩先生的客人出席同兴楼酒楼的聚会，其中包括八名日本人。五名中国歌女被叫来助兴，表演者中有一位著名的中国歌手，名叫“双红”。一切都很愉快，直到大约9点30分，八名日本人中的六人离开。

三名枪手闯入

在送他们上车后，几名中国客人和任先生回到餐桌旁。正当聚会进行得热火朝天时，晚上9点53分，三名枪手闯入房间并立即开火。据餐厅其他食客称，刺客开了20多枪，枪声接连不断，听起来像机枪射击。

任道恩先生身中数弹倒地，那名歌女也当场死亡。在一片巨大的混乱中，甚至在餐厅住客和街头路人四处躲避时，三名刺客成功逃脱。似乎没有人注意到他们的进入，调查人员只获得了关于这些人的模糊描述。

警方赶赴现场

枪击发生后几分钟内，老闸捕房接到警报，并立即将所有可用人员派往暴行现场。后备队当时恰好在该地区执勤，随即被派往餐厅。

警方到达时，发现现场一片混乱。桌子被掀翻，客人们在疯狂逃命时打碎了大量瓷器。被杀的男女躺在血泊中，而另外五人捂着伤口。

紧急救护车

很快呼叫了紧急救护车，伤者被迅速送往莱斯中国医院。警方封锁了餐厅的所有出口，并对所有在场人员进行了讯问。

高级警务官员在后备队到达后几分钟内赶到现场，其中包括副总监 H. D. M. Robertson。老闸捕房的侦探督察 A. R. Bennett 负责此案。

枪击发生时在场的两名日本客人随警方前往老闸捕房。其中一人是佛教僧侣。他们自称长岛 (Nagatima) 和高仓 (Takura)。

569

'Reformed' Official,
Singsong Girl Shot
Dead In Restaurant

Jen Pao-an Killed
As He Entertains
Japanese

MUSICIAN, GUEST
SERIOUSLY INJURED

Gunmen Discard Mausers
In Making Calm
Getaway

By C. D. ALCOTT

Mr. Jen Pao-an, head of the "Land Bureau of the Reformed Municipal Government of Shanghai," entered the Dong Shing Lou restaurant, at 435 Foochow Road, last night to play host to a party of friends. At exactly 10.10 p.m., about one hour after his entrance, he left the establishment as a corpse.

He was the victim of one of the coldest assassinations that has ever been carried out in Shanghai in modern times.

While his party was just beginning to get underway, two gunmen, both armed with Mausers, entered the crowded restaurant, marched across the main dining room and walked into the private room engaged by Mr. Jen.

The slayers immediately opened fire. When the smoke of the shooting had cleared away, Mr. Jen was dead, bullets having struck him in the body and head. A sing-song girl, Miss Chang Hung, also lay dead on the floor in a pool of her own blood, with a bullet in her head.

Suffering from wounds, but still alive, were Mr. K. Y. Chow, a musician who had been called in as an accompanist for the sing-song girl. The other wounded person was a man named M. O. Yao, evidently one of the guests.

Japanese Guests Unhurt

Several Japanese guests, reported to have been in Mr. Jen's private dining room at the time, contrived to make their escape from the hail of bullets fired by the killers.

To get the full import of the assassination of Mr. Jen, picture a large Chinese restaurant and its main dining room, located on the second floor. Imagine this same dining room filled with patrons and hustling Chinese waiters. Also picture a large private rear dining room at the rear of the main floor.

From this point, conjure two killers, Mausers concealed beneath their long gowns, weaving their way among the crowded tables of the main dining room to the private room. Then imagine these gunmen, standing in the doorway of the private room, surveying the gathered guests for a few seconds and then opening a murderous, withering fire in such crowded quarters. When you have done this, you will have a fairly correct picture of what happened at the Dong Shing Lou Restaurant last night. And the exact time that Mausers of the two gunmen commenced barking was 9.45 p.m.

Panic Breaks Loose

Panic broke loose in both the private and public dining rooms. Women screamed and crawled under tables. Their white-faced male escorts, some of them too frightened to scream, stood rooted in their tracks. Others made a break for the main entrance and ran, tumbled or fell headlong down the large marble stairway. Tables and dishes were upset. Food was splattered all over the place. After it was all over, it took more than three hours for still shaking waiters and coolies to clean up the mess.

But despite the panic, the two gunmen remained cool and in complete possession of their faculties. They made their way through the screaming, terrorized people in the main dining room, managed to get downstairs and out into the open. On their way out of the premises, they threw away their Mausers. Once free of the maddened, panicky crowd, they dashed down the street, accompanied by a third man who had apparently been left to stand guard on the ground floor, in front of the entrance.

It has been established that they turned off Foochow Road onto Shantung Road. Two Mauser cartridge clips were found some time later in front of the Lester Chinese Hospital, which is located on the same street. The clips were mute evidence as to which way the gunmen had fled after carrying out their killing.

Old Hands At Game

The fact that they threw away their guns after the shooting is evidence that the pair were old hands at the game of murder. Shanghai police know well that it is easier to solve a killing in which the gunmen hang onto their weapons.

In cases of the latter sort, when the police get the gun they also usually get the killer. But when guns are thrown away after assassinations of the sort committed last night, it is a difficult job to connect killer and the gun later on.

Detectives of the Louza Police Station, headed by Detective Sub-Inspector George Bennett, arrived on the scene of the shooting a few minutes after it occurred. Shortly after they had had sufficient opportunity to examine the bodies, assassinations of the sort committed and wounded were taken to the Lester Chinese Hospital. Both Chow and Yao were still alive early this morning but the condition of the former was serious and he may not live.

“维新”官员，
歌女在餐馆被枪杀

任保安在宴请
日本人时遇害

乐师、客人
重伤

枪手丢弃毛瑟枪
从容逃离

作者：C. D. ALCOTT

上海特别市政府土地局局长任保安先生昨晚前往福州路435号东兴楼餐馆，做东宴请一群朋友。就在他进入餐馆约一小时后的晚上10点10分整，他离开该场所时已是一具尸体。

他是近代上海发生的最冷酷的暗杀案之一的受害者。

当他的聚会刚刚开始进行时，两名手持毛瑟枪的枪手进入了拥挤的餐馆，穿过主餐厅，走进了任先生预订的包间。

凶手立即开火。枪烟散去后，任先生已经死亡，子弹击中了他的身体和头部。一名名叫张红（音译）小姐的歌女也倒在血泊中身亡，头部中弹。

受伤但仍活着的是K. Y. Chow先生，他是一名被请来为歌女伴奏的乐师。另一名伤者是名为M. O. Yao的男子，显然是客人之一。

日本客人未受伤

据报道，当时在任先生私人包间内的几名日本客人，设法从杀手射出的弹雨中逃脱。

要充分了解任先生被暗杀事件的全部含义，请想象一家大型中式餐馆及其位于二楼的主餐厅。想象这个同样的餐厅里挤满了顾客和忙碌的中国侍者。再想象一楼后部有一个大型私人后餐厅。

从这个角度，设想两名杀手，长袍下藏着毛瑟枪，在主餐厅拥挤的餐桌间穿梭，走向包间。然后想象这些枪手站在包间门口，审视聚集的客人几秒钟，然后在如此拥挤的空间里展开致命的、毁灭性的射击。当你做到这一点时，你就对昨晚在东兴楼餐馆发生的事情有了相当准确的画面。而两名枪手的毛瑟枪开始咆哮的确切时间是晚上9点45分。

恐慌爆发

私人包间和公共餐厅都陷入了恐慌。女人们尖叫着爬到桌子底下。她们面色苍白的男伴，有些人吓得连叫都叫不出来，呆立在原地。其他人则冲向正门，跑着、跌跌撞撞或头朝下摔下巨大的大理石楼梯。桌椅被打翻。食物溅得到处都是。一切结束后，仍在颤抖的侍者和苦力花了三个多小时才清理完这片狼藉。

尽管一片恐慌，两名枪手却保持冷静，完全掌控着自己的神智。他们穿过主餐厅里尖叫、惊恐的人群，设法下楼并走到户外。在离开现场的路上，他们扔掉了毛瑟枪。一旦摆脱了疯狂、恐慌的人群，他们便沿着街道飞奔而去，随行的还有第三名男子，此人显然被留在底层入口处望风。

经查实，他们从福州路转入山东路。一段时间后，在同一条街道上的莱斯德华人医院（Lester Chinese Hospital）门前发现了两个毛瑟枪弹夹。这些弹夹无声地证明了枪手在实施杀人后逃跑的方向。

作案老手

他们在射击后扔掉枪支的事实证明，这两人是谋杀行当的老手。上海警方深知，如果枪手保留武器，破案会更容易。

在后一种情况下，当警方拿到枪时，通常也能抓到杀手。但是，当像昨晚那样在暗杀后扔掉枪支时，事后将杀手与枪支联系起来是一项困难的工作。

由副督察乔治·贝内特（George Bennett）率领的老闸捕房侦探在枪击发生后几分钟内抵达现场。在他们有足够机会检查尸体后不久，此类暗杀案中的死者和伤者被送往莱斯德华人医院。周（Chow）和姚（Yao）在今天清晨仍然活着，但前者的情况严重，可能无法存活。

吴德仔持有工部局于1938年6月2日签发的

从同一弄堂内的29号搬至该地址。我们也走访了
该地址，但再次未发现任何具有指控性质的物品。

他的妻子吴陈氏（Woo Zung Sa）陈述，他于八年前
与她结婚，自那时起

had always been employed as chauffeur (sometimes at

time left Shanghai.

Whilst the party was visiting the addresses men-
tioned, Zau Ts Sung (趙樹森), alias Choo Ts Sung
(周樹森) (detained in connection with this case)
was removed from the cells at Louza Station to this office
where he was shown the photograph on the driving permit

On the party returning to this office with Woo Tuh

but again no identification was made.

The undersigned and D.S.I. Chu Shou Ling were

Upon questioning, the fruitless visit to his home

It was learned from Sergeant-Major H. Katoda that

一直受雇为司机（有时在不同地点），且他本人从未在任何时候离开过上海。

当调查小组走访上述地址时，赵树森（Zau Ts Sung），又名周树森（Choo Ts Sung）（因本案被拘留），从老闸捕房拘留所被带至本办公室，向其出示了吴土仔（Woo Tuh Zai）驾驶执照上的照片。他未能辨认出照片中所示的男子。

当调查小组带着吴土仔返回本办公室时，让他与赵树森当面指认，但再次未能进行辨认。

具名人与警探副督察朱守玲（Chu Shou Ling）获准对该男子进行讯问，但未获得任何有用信息。

鉴于对其住所的探访毫无结果，且赵树森未能将其认出，目前看来吴土仔似乎并未参与此次暗杀行动。

据警长 H. Katoda 称，吴土仔将被暂时拘留，以待有关他的进一步消息。

报告内容如下：-
“1938年5月2日，一名身份不明的中国男子在布罗迪·克拉克路（Rue Brodie A. Clarke）11号被谋杀（法国警察）。该弹壳经鉴定，系由1938年6月18日在福州路435号谋杀邢基思（Hying Kyi S）案中使用的四支枪支之一所射出。”
（注：并非由警察到达现场时发现的两支手枪中的任何一支发射。）
1938年9月12日，特区法院就赵树森（Chao Ts Sung，秦树森），又名赵树森（Tsu Ts Sung，趙樹森）一案，向总局递交了一份请愿书和通知书。

1938年9月6日代表赵树森之母赵宗氏（Chao Zung Sz，赵宗氏）向法院提交，简要强调了以下事实：赵树森因涉嫌参与本案而被老闸捕房逮捕，但应警方请求，特区法院因证据不足随后将其释放。然而，尽管法院已将其释放，他目前仍被警方拘留，此举构成对法庭的蔑视，因此请求特区法院命令上海公共租界工部局警务处要么立即释放他，要么将其提审至特区法院依法处理。

加盖特区法院公章的“通知书”证实了以下事实：赵树森在被上海公共租界工部局警务处凭拘留令羁押后，于1938年8月4日根据特区法院的命令获释。

鉴于赵树森（又名赵树森）目前正根据1938年7月19日公告条款以及如前文日记所述的警务处副处长指令被拘留，特此恭敬地呈交本案卷宗以候进一步指示。

mentioned she was not to return home until he had got

    She left the house about 8 p.m. and went to the
straw hut off Kiaoehow Road. The following morning
she heard from other dwellers (she cannot read) that
a shooting affray had taken place at a restaurant
on Foochow Road and also a male giving his name as Zau
Ts Sung was detained in hospital suffering from bullet
wounds. The name given was that of her son and in view
of what she had been told the night previously she de-
cided not to return home. She later heard that the
injured male had been placed on a Writ of Detention and
also that it had subsequently been withdrawn at the
request of Police. After an elapse of several days her
son had not communicated with her and she began to wonder
what had transpired. In order to assist her she asked
her nephew Zung Van Yoeng (鄭高榮), a barber working
and residing at the Mei Ya (美亞) barber shop, Peking
Road to make enquiries. In this he proved unsuccessful
but he requested one Zung Shing Ming (陳解民), a lawyer
residing Lane 563/7 Burkill Road who used to visit the
barber shop, to write a letter to Police asking the
whereabouts of Chao Ts Sung.

被提及，她在儿子与她取得联系之前不得回家。
    她于晚上8点左右离开家，前往胶州路附近的草棚。第二天早上，她从其他住户那里得知（她不识字），福州路的一家餐馆发生了枪击事件，还有一名自称赵树森的男子因枪伤住院接受治疗。所报姓名正是她儿子的名字，鉴于前一晚得到的嘱咐，她决定不回家。后来她听说受伤男子已被签发拘留令，随后又应警方请求撤销了该令。几天过去后，她的儿子仍未与她联系，她开始疑惑发生了什么事。为了寻求帮助，她让她的侄子郑高荣（Zung Van Yoeng，鄭高榮）去打听消息，郑高荣是一名理发师，在北京路美亚（Mei Ya）理发店工作并居住。但他未能打听到消息，于是请求一位曾光顾该理发店、居住在伯奇尔路（Burkill Road）563/7弄的律师陈解民（Zung Shing Ming，陳解民）写信给警方，询问赵树森的下落。

This resulted in two letters, one dated 11-8-38
and the other 19-8-38 being sent to Headquarters
requesting the desired information. It was as a result
of interviewing the lawyer that the mother of Chao Ts
Sung was located.

Chao Zung Se identified the blood stained long
gown and two keys picked up on Shantung Road together
with two magazines containing ammunition as the property
of her son. She also identified Chao Ts Sung as her son.

On him being confronted by his mother and the
evidence which she had given which was at variance with
that given by him in two statements made to Police, he
finally capitulated and admitted having taken part in
this crime.

A voluntary statement (copy attached) was taken
from him in which he outlines his knowledge of the crime.

He led detectives to the Doeng Shing Lao (同兴楼)
Restaurant, 435 Foochow Road where he demonstrated what
had taken place. Contrary to statements of witnesses,
the assassins did not proceed to the dining room engaged
by Hyung Chi Fu (任济时) by climbing the stairway.
The assassins, seven in number including Chao Ts Sung,
engaged rooms No.3 & 5 (it is actually two rooms made
into one) which is on the first floor and opposite the
head of the stairway. An usher Lieu You Er (柳毓厚)

赵宗氏（Chao Zung Se）辨认出在山东路拾获的血迹斑斑的长衫和两把钥匙，以及两本装有子弹的杂志为其儿子的财产。她还辨认出赵树森就是她的儿子。

当让其母亲与其对质，并出示其母提供的与其此前向警方所作两份陈述相矛盾的证据时，他最终屈服，承认参与了此次犯罪。

对他进行了一次自愿陈述（附副本），他在其中概述了他对该罪行的了解。

他带领警探前往福州路435号同兴楼（Doeng Shing Lao）餐馆，演示了当时发生的情况。与证人陈述相反，刺客们并非通过楼梯爬上任济时（Hyung Chi Fu）包下的餐厅。包括赵树森在内的七名刺客预订了3号和5号房间（实际上是打通的两个房间），该房间位于二楼，正对楼梯口。一名侍者柳毓厚（Lieu You Er）

stated that a deposit of $5.00 had been paid for the
room and food to the value of $6.00 or $7.00 had been
eaten by the six or seven occupants but not paid for.
On the shooting taking place, and after Police enquiries,
it was noticed that the occupants of the room, like
others also, had left the premises but nothing further
was thought of it. He did not identify Chao Ts Sung
as one of the occupants of the room on the night in
question.

The assassins, Chao Ts Sung, Wong Tseu Feh (王守法),
Tsang (张) and four others names unknown, divided
themselves into two groups of four and three respectively
The four consisted of Tsang and three of the four males,
names unknown. The three consisted of Wong Tseu Feh,
Chao Ts Sung and one of the four males, name unknown.
The four, each armed, left the room and took up positions
at advantageous places to prevent people from leaving
the premises and also to caution them not to move as
a "traitor was about to be shot."

On the orders of "Don't move" being given, the
remaining three left the room and proceeded across the
hallway, down a passage and go to the room wherein Myung
Chi Tu was entertaining friends. Chao Ts Sung alleges
he was brought in at the last minute to assist in the

刺客赵树森、王守法（Wong Tseu Feh）、张（Tsang）及其他四名姓名不详者，分为两组，分别为四人和三人。四人组由张及另外三名姓名不详的男子组成。三人组由王守法、赵树森及另外四名男子中一名姓名不详者组成。这四名持械者离开房间，占据有利位置，以防止人们离开现场，并警告他们不要动，因为“即将枪决一名叛徒”。

在发出“不许动”的命令后，剩下的三人离开房间，穿过大厅，沿通道前行，进入杨继祖（Myung Chi Tu，音译）正在招待朋友的房间。赵树森声称他是最后一刻才被叫来协助

Zau Ts Zung (趙樹森)
Yangchow D.S. Fowler
C '8' C.B.H.Q. 29-8-38 D.S.I. Liao Chung Chien

My name is Chao Ts Sung (趙樹森) alias Zau Ts
Sung (喬樹森) aged 30, native of Yangchow and residing
together with my mother Chao Zung Sz (喬鄭氏) at No. 17
Foh Hsien Lee off Rue Tenant de la Tour, F.C.

I have a younger brother Chao Tsung Yue (趙春)
alias Zau Tsung Dee (趙春弟) age 25 who is at present in
Hankow serving with the Chinese army in the engineering corps.
I last saw him in Shanghai in September 1937 when he left for
Nanking and then Hankow.

I was born in Yangchow on the 5th day of the 10th
moon 1908. At the age of five I studied under a private tutor
at home until I was nine and then joined the Zung Teh Primary
School at Lee Wan, Yangchow, and stayed there until twelve
years of age. I then became an apprentice in the Dah Shing
Tsang grocery shop, Yangchow, for three years and then joined
a normal school and stayed there until I was seventeen.

At this time my parents were in straitened circum-
stances and I left the school to become apprenticed to the
Dah Tao Sung shoe shop, Yangchow where I stayed until I was 20.

Up to this time I had not received any teachings of
a political nature but when about 18 I used to listen to army
propagandists extolling the virtues of the then newly-established
Chiang Kai-shek regime. I became interested but took no active
part.

When twenty years of age I received a letter from
one named Tang (唐), a friend living in Shanghai. This
person asked me to go to Shanghai as he could secure me a good
page_data.zh:
赵树宗（Zau Ts Zung，趙樹森）
扬州 警探副督察 Fowler
C '8' 刑事科总部 1938年8月29日 警探副督察 廖仲坚（Liao Chung Chien）

我叫赵树森（趙樹森），又名乔树森（Zau Ts Sung，喬樹森），现年30岁，扬州人，与母亲赵郑氏（Chao Zung Sz，喬鄭氏）同住于法租界唐恩德路（Rue Tenant de la Tour）附近佛仙里17号。

我有一个弟弟赵春（Chao Tsung Yue，趙春），又名赵春弟（Zau Tsung Dee，趙春弟），现年25岁，目前在汉口服役于中国军队工兵部队。我最后一次见到他是1937年9月在上海，当时他前往南京，随后去了汉口。

我于1908年农历十月初五出生于扬州。五岁时在家跟随私塾老师学习，直到九岁，随后进入扬州李湾的崇德小学（Zung Teh Primary School，音译）就读，直至十二岁。之后我在扬州大兴昌（Dah Shing Tsang，音译）杂货店当了三年学徒，然后进入一所师范学校，直至十七岁。

当时我的父母家境窘迫，我离开学校，成为扬州大陶松（Dah Tao Sung，音译）鞋店的学徒，在那里待到二十岁。

在此之前，我没有接受过任何政治性质的教导，但在十八岁左右，我常常听军队宣传员宣扬当时新建立的蒋介石政权的优点。我产生了兴趣，但未积极参与。

二十岁时，我收到一封来自住在上海的一位姓唐（Tang）的朋友的信。此人邀请我去上海，因为他能为我谋得一份好

page_data.en:
2. Continued.

position in a silversmiths' shop. I came to Shanghai in June
but the job offered me did not materialise. I eventually
secured work for three months with a shoemaker who had a stall
in an alleyway off Haining Road.
At this time I met my sister Chao Tsung Zung (趙春蓉
( now deceased ) who was living off Robison Road and working
at the N.Y.K. No.7 mill. With money borrowed from her and
that which I had saved I started a shoemaking stall myself in
the Western district. I lived with my sister and whilst there
learned of the conditions under which the mill employees were
working and finally became resolved to try and do something
to assist my countrymen.
At the age of 21 I joined the 9th Army as a recruit
and was stationed in Nantao under General Koo Ts Tsung (顧竹
同 ). I was later transferred to the Kuomintang branch
in the army because of my taking an interest in that work.
At the age of 24 ( or nearly so ) I left the army
and became a clerk in the Registry of the Great China Universit
in Chungsan Road. I stayed there for about one year and then,
with my savings opened an egg shop on Ferry Road but after
about a year had to close same because of business depression.
Whilst in the egg business I became acquainted with
one Wong Wah Chung (黃華羣) who professed himself a
Communist and tried to get me to join his party. I explained
that I had formerly worked for the Kuomintang party and there-
fore would never be associated with Communists.
On closing the egg business I again met Wong Wah
page_data.zh:
2. 续。

在一家银匠铺里的职位。我于六月来到上海，但提供给我的工作并未落实。最终，我在海宁路一条小巷里的一位鞋匠那里做了三个月的工。
在此期间，我遇到了我的姐姐赵春蓉（现已去世），她住在罗宾森路（Robison Road）附近，在日本邮船会社（N.Y.K.）第七纱厂工作。用从她那里借来的钱和我自己的积蓄，我在西区自己开了一个修鞋摊。我和姐姐住在一起，在那里我了解了纱厂工人的工作状况，并最终决心尝试做些事情来帮助我的同胞。
21岁时，我作为新兵加入第九军，驻扎在南市，隶属于顾竹同将军麾下。后来因为我对这项工作感兴趣，被调至军队中的国民党分部。
24岁（或接近此年龄）时，我离开军队，成为中山路大中华大学注册处的职员。我在那里待了大约一年，然后用积蓄在渡轮路（Ferry Road）开了一家蛋行，但由于生意萧条，大约一年后不得不关闭。
在做鸡蛋生意期间，我结识了一位名叫黄华羣的人，他自称是共产党员，并试图让我加入他的党派。我解释说，我以前曾为国民党工作，因此绝不会与共产党人有任何关联。
关闭蛋行后，我再次遇到黄华

page_data.en:
3. Continued.

Chung who explained he had gone over to the Kuomintang party
and been accepted by them. He further explained that he
could get me a position as clerk with the Military Affairs
Commission of the Nanking Government. I accepted the offer
and was subsequently posted to Nanking.

Since that time and until my arrest I have always
been connected in some capacity with the Military Affairs
Commission at Nanking, Hangchow, Soochow or Shanghai.

Whilst serving in Hangchow I came into contact
with one Woo Tah Zung ( 吴 德 仁 ) a native of Hupeh, who
was a lecturer on politics in the Police Officers training
institute there. He was a staunch supporter of Chiang Kai-
shek and impressed me very much indeed.

On being transferred to Shanghai for the Sino-
Japanese hostilities in 1937 I again met Woo Tah Zung in
Kantao. At this time he was chief of the 15th Regiment of
the Special service Corps whilst I was appointed section
chief of the Arms and Ammunition department of the same Corps.

On the Chinese troops retreating from Shanghai
in November 1937, I made my way into the French Concession
and succeeded in locating my mother who was living in a straw
hut off Kiaochow Road. Having lived there until the 17-11-37
we moved to No. 17 Poh Hsien Lee off Rue Tenant de la Tour,
F.C. where we occupied an upstairs back room at a monthly
rental of $8.00.

About the beginning of December I was walking
along Avenue Joffre when I met Woo Tah Zung. We spoke of our
page_data.zh:
3. 续。

华羣，他解释说他已转投国民党并被接纳。他还解释说，他可以为我谋得南京政府军事委员会的一个职员职位。我接受了这一提议，随后被派往南京。

从那时起直到我被捕，我一直以某种身份与南京、杭州、苏州或上海的军事委员会有关联。

在杭州任职期间，我接触了一位名叫吴德仁的湖北人，他是当地警察军官训练所的政治讲师。他是蒋介石的坚定支持者，给我留下了非常深刻的印象。

1937年中日敌对行动爆发，我被调往上海，在闸北再次遇到吴德仁。当时他是特务团第十五团团长，而我被任命为该团军械处处长。

1937年11月中国军队从上海撤退时，我进入法租界，并成功找到了住在胶州路附近一间草棚里的母亲。我们在那里住到1937年11月17日，随后搬至法租界唐恩路（Rue Tenant de la Tour）附近的泊仙里17号，我们在那里租用了一间后楼，月租金为8.00元。

十二月初左右，我在霞飞路行走时遇到了吴德仁。我们谈到了我们的

page_data.en:
4. Continued.

experiences and I mentioned that I was going to try and
rejoin the Chinese Army. Woo told me that it would be very
difficult as the troops had retreated farther inland and
consequently the Japanese were all around Shanghai. He told
me to stay in Shanghai and whilst here I could draw on him
for money. I took him to my home and asked him where he
was living. He merely said " Sinsa Road " and would not
give me any number.

From that time onwards he used to come to my home
once every week or ten days. On these visits he used to use
my writing table for the writing of dispatches etc. but the
nature of them I do not know. On occasions I was sent to
Zoo Ka Zah Park, F.C. to wait by the pool in there for
dispatches from members under Woo.

I do not know any of the persons whom I met. The
method of receiving the dispatches was as follows :- I was
to stand by the pool in the park and at intervals place a
leaf between my lips. On this action being observed by a
member he would discreetly do likewise and then hand me the
dispatch. Another method of signalling sometimes used was
to pick up a certain corner of my long gown ( on the occasion
I did it it was the left corner of the front half of the gown
and this would also be done by the member wishing to hand me
a dispatch.

I remember that a total of about seven or eight
males visited my home at different times together with Woo
Tah Sung. Of the males I only knew one named Lee ( 李 )
page_data.zh:
4. 续。

经历，我提到我打算尝试重新加入中国军队。吴告诉我，这将非常困难，因为部队已向内陆深处撤退，因此日军遍布上海周围。他让我留在上海，并说在此期间我可以向他借钱。我带他去了我家，问他住在哪里。他只说是“新萨路”（Sinsa Road，音译），不肯给我具体的门牌号。

从那时起，他每隔一周或十天就会来我家一次。在这些访问中，他常使用我的写字台撰写公文等，但我不知道这些公文的性质。有时，我被派往法租界的兆丰公园（Zoo Ka Zah Park，即今中山公园），在园内的池塘边等待吴的手下送来的公文。

我不认识我所遇到的任何人。接收公文的方法如下：我要站在公园的池塘边，并不时将一片叶子放在嘴唇间。当一名成员观察到这一动作时，他会谨慎地做同样的动作，然后将公文交给我。另一种有时使用的信号方法是提起长衫的某个角（在我这样做的时候，是提起长衫前半部分的左下角），希望向我递交公文的成员也会这样做。

我记得连同吴德仁在内，共有大约七八名男性在不同时间访问过我家。在这些男性中，我只认识一位姓李的人，

page_data.en:
5. Continued.

who spoke Mandarin dialect with a Cantonese accent. He was
Woo Tuh Zung's secretary.

In February 1938 I was asked by Woo to open a room
in an lodging house behind the Nanking Theatre, F.C. and
divide into fourteen a quantity of pamphlets which would be
sent to me. These were to be handed to fourteen persons
who would hand me a slip of paper bearing the words " Please
give bearer a packet of letter paper ". Each was to be
signed with the character Sung ( 4 ). The following day
a chauffeur brought two bundles of pamphlets to the room
which I had engaged. ( I don't remember the number. ) The
pamphlets merely urged the people to support the war of
resistance. I divided them into fourteen portions and the
next day handed them to fourteen males who gave the necessary
slip of paper. I have never seen the males before. Acting
on the instructions of Woo Tuh Zung I tore up the slips of
paper as they were presented. As soon as the pamphlets were
distributed by me I left the lodging house.

About the end of April I was taken ill and was
treated by a Chinese herbalist. I did not improve and
finally, about the middle of May, went to a hospital on Rue
Lafayette, F.C. near the Lafayette Gardens, where I was
detained suffering from typhoid fever. I was discharged on
the 5-6-38. My expenses were paid by Woo Tuh Zung.

On the 8-6-38 Woo came to my home and asked how
I was feeling. I told him that I was cured but still very
weak. He told me to rest and he would see me later. I did
page_data.zh:
5. 续。

他说带有广东口音的普通话。他是吴德仁的秘书。

1938年2月，吴要求我在法租界南京大戏院后面的一家旅馆里开一个房间，并将寄给我的一批小册子分成十四份。这些小册子要交给十四个人，他们会递给我一张纸条，上面写着“请给持条人一包信纸”。每张纸条都要签上“宋”字。第二天，一名司机将两捆小册子送到我租下的房间。（我不记得具体数量了。）这些小册子只是呼吁民众支持抗战。我将它们分成十四份，第二天交给了十四名男性，他们递上了必要的纸条。我以前从未见过这些人。按照吴德仁的指示，我在收到纸条时将其撕毁。小册子分发完毕后，我离开了那家旅馆。

四月底左右，我生病了，由一位中医治疗。病情没有好转，最终在五月中旬左右，我住进了法租界拉斐特路（Rue Lafayette，即今淮海中路）靠近拉斐特花园的一家医院，因患伤寒而被留院治疗。我于1938年6月5日出院。我的费用由吴德仁支付。

1938年6月8日，吴来到我家，询问我的感觉如何。我告诉他我已经痊愈，但仍然非常虚弱。他让我休息，说稍后再来看我。我没有

page_data.en:
6. Continued.

not see him again until about 11 a.m. on the 18-6-38. None
of his friends had visited me.

On Woo coming to my home at about 11 a.m. on the
18-6-38 he told me that two males named Wong Tsun Poh (王字
法) and Tsang (張) would visit my home during the
afternoon and they were to be told to await Woo. I had met
these two men in February in Koo Ka Zah Park after being
introduced to them by Woo.

At 1 p.m. the two arrived and I gave them Woo's
message and spoke of things in general until the arrival of
Woo shortly after 2 p.m. Wang Tsun Poh was wearing a fawn
coloured foreign style suit whilst Tsang wore a white silk
shirt with white foreign style trousers. Woo was wearing
a grey coloured foreign style suit. I went out to buy some
cigarettes and on my return heard Wang Tsun Poh say to Woo
that he required eight pistols and Woo reply that he would
let him have them later. Woo also told Wang Tsun Poh to
engage a room. The three accepted cigarettes and after
smoking them for a few minutes they left the house.

At 7 p.m. Woo Pak Sung again visited my home and
handed me a packet wrapped in white paper saying it was a
magazine containing ammunition and asked me to take it to
Wang Tsun Poh who had engaged a room in the Kwong Shing Lee
Restaurant, Des Voeux Road in his own name and was waiting for
the ammunition. Woo also told me they were going to assass-
inate a traitor by the name of ' Byung Guk, at that time
was giving a dinner to his friends in the Kwong Shing Lee
page_data.zh:
6. 续。

再见到他，直到1938年6月18日上午11点左右。期间他的朋友都没有来看过我。

1938年6月18日上午11点左右，吴来到我家，告诉我两名男子，名叫王字法（Wong Tsun Poh）和张某（Tsang），将在下午访问我家，并告知他们等待吴的到来。今年二月，经吴介绍，我在兆丰公园（Koo Ka Zah Park）见过这两个人。

下午1点，两人到达，我传达了吴的口信，并与他们闲聊一般事务，直到下午2点后不久吴到达。王字法穿着一套米色的西式西装，而张某穿着白丝绸衬衫配白色西式长裤。吴穿着一套灰色的西式西装。我出去买了一些香烟，回来时听到王字法对吴说他需要八支手枪，吴回答说稍后会给他。吴还告诉王字法去开一个房间。三人接过香烟，抽了几分钟后离开了房子。

晚上7点，吴柏松（Woo Pak Sung，音译，疑即前文吴德仁）再次来到我家，递给我一个白纸包裹的包裹，说里面是一盒装有子弹的弹夹，让我把它交给王字法。王字法已以自己的名义在德威路（Des Voeux Road，即今延安中路）的广兴隆酒楼（Kwong Shing Lee Restaurant）开好了房间，正在等待弹药。吴还告诉我，他们计划刺杀一名名为“Byung Guk”（音译）的汉奸，当时此人正在广兴隆酒楼宴请朋友。

page_data.en:
7. Continued.

Restaurant. Woo further remarked that he had just received
information that several Japanese were also attending the
dinner given by ' Nyung ' and he ( Woo ) did not want Wong
Tseu Fah to do anything until the Japanese had left the
place because should a Japanese be killed or injured it would
cause serious trouble in the Settlement and not assist their
(Woo and his confederates) plans in any way. He had there-
fore decided to send me with the ammunition to Wong and to
tell him regarding the Japanese.

I was also instructed that, after giving Wong the
ammunition and the message, I was to leave the restaurant
and loiter about in the vicinity until after the assassina-
tion and then make brief enquiries as to what had occurred
and the casualties and report to Woo at 10 p.m. at the
corner of Avenue Joffre and Rue Cardinal Mercier. Woo then
left my home.

I left my home between 7.30 p.m. and 8 p.m. and pro-
ceeded by a route No.38 m/bus to the corner of Avenue Edward
VII and Szech Road from where I walked to the Boeng Shing
Lou Restaurant, Foochow Road. I arrived there at about
8.30 p.m. or 9 p.m. and located Wong Tseu Fah and Tsang
and four other males, names unknown - I had not met them
before - in room No.5 & 6 on the first floor which is just
opposite the stairway.

I gave Woo's message regarding the Japanese to Wong
but forgot to hand him the magazine of ammunition. He
instructed me to go outside and observe when the Japanese
page_data.zh:
7. 续。

吴进一步评论说，他刚收到消息，几名日本人也参加了“Nyung”（音译，指前述汉奸）举办的宴会，他（吴）不希望王字法（Wong Tseu Fah，即王字法）在日本人离开该地点之前采取任何行动，因为如果日本人被杀或受伤，将在租界引起严重麻烦，并且无助于他们（吴及其同伙）的计划。因此，他决定派我带着弹药去找王，并告知他关于日本人的情况。

我还接到指示，在给王弹药和口信后，我要离开酒楼，在附近徘徊，直到暗杀行动结束后，简要询问发生的情况和伤亡人数，并于晚上10点在霞飞路与梅尔西埃主教路（Rue Cardinal Mercier，即今重庆南路）转角处向吴报告。随后吴离开了我家。

我在晚上7:30到8:00之间离开家，乘坐38路公共汽车前往爱德华七世路（Avenue Edward VII，即今延安东路）与四川路的转角，然后步行至福州路的博盛楼（Boeng Shing Lou，音译）餐厅。我大约在晚上8:30或9:00到达那里，在一楼正对楼梯的5号和6号房间里找到了王字法和张某，以及另外四名男性，姓名不详——我以前没见过他们。

我向王传达了吴关于日本人的口信，但忘了把装有子弹的弹夹交给他。他指示我到外面去观察日本人何时

page_data.en:
8 continued.

left. I waited outside the restaurant about three quarters
of an hour and then saw five or six Japanese males leave
by m/car and took it for granted they were the ones refer-
red to and I went inside again and reported to Wong. He
informed me that he had insufficient men and asked me to
assist him. I agreed and he handed me an automatic mauser
pistol. I don't know how many pistols were in possession
of the group but I know Wong carried two, one in each hand.
Wong ordered Tsang and three of the males not known to
me to go outside the room and order the people round about not
to move. I heard commands of "Don't move" and "We are going
to shoot a traitor." At that time Wong ordered me and a
male unknown to me to accompany him. We three left the room
and proceeded across a hall-way and into a passage and along
this until we came to the room engaged by Nying. This was
pointed out to me by Wong. I had been told on leave the
room to cover Wong and the other male whilst they were
shooting but on finding myself first in the room I was
momentarily at a loss. I, however, shouted "Don't move"
to the occupants of the room and to enforce this fired one
shot. At that moment I felt my right arm go numb as I
heard firing behind me. I dropped my pistol and grabbed
at my right arm with my left hand. Realising I had been
wounded and feeling dazed I made my way out of the room,
down the passage and down the stairs to Foochow Road and
turn east. What with having only just recovered from ill-
ness and the loss of blood from my wound I was overcome with
page_data.zh:
8. 续。

离开。我在餐厅外等了大约三刻钟，然后看到五六名日本男子乘汽车离开，我想当然地认为他们就是所指的那些人，于是我再次进去向王报告。他告诉我他人手不足，请求我协助。我同意了，他递给我一支毛瑟自动手枪。我不知道这群人拥有多少支手枪，但我知道王携带了两支，每只手一支。王命令张某和三名我不认识的男子到房间外面，命令周围的人不要动。我听到“不许动”和“我们要枪毙一个汉奸”的命令。当时，王命令我和另一名我不认识的男子陪同他。我们三人离开房间，穿过大厅，进入一条通道，沿着通道走，直到来到宁（Nying，音译）预订的房间。这是王指给我看的。离开房间时，我被告知要在王和另一名男子射击时进行掩护，但当我发现自己第一个进入房间时，一时不知所措。然而，我还是对房间里的人大喊“不许动”，为了强制执行这一命令，我开了一枪。就在那一刻，我感到右臂麻木，因为我听到身后有枪声。我丢下手枪，用左手抓住右臂。意识到自己受了伤并感到头晕目眩，我走出房间，沿通道下楼，来到福州路并向东转弯。由于刚刚病愈，加上伤口失血，我因

page_data.en:
9 continued.

weakness and Wong, Tsang and the other males passed me.
I called to them re my condition and Wong and one of the unknown
males stayed beside me and assisted as much as possible.
On reaching Shantung Road I felt myself becoming weaker and
in order to avoid detection as much as possible I, with the
help of Wong and the other male, discarded the magazine given
to me to give to Wong but which I had forgotten to do; two
keys, one of the back door of my home and the other to the
door of my room, and finally, my long gown.

We turned south down Shantung Road and my condition
becoming worse, the unknown male wearing a white suit called
ricksha and I told the coolie to go to the Paulun Hospital,
that being the only one I knew, not having any money to pay
the ricksha fare I told the coolie to call at the hospital
tomorrow.

From the Paulun Hospital I was removed to the Lester
Hospital and finally to the Police Hospital. Whilst in the
latter hospital I made two statements, one on the 19-6-38
and the other on the 7-7-38. I now wish to cancel those
statements as this is the true one.

During my conversations with Woo Tuh Zung he told me
that the Settlement authorities and Police were neutral
therefore if I was ever in difficulties with them I was to
deny participation or knowledge of the offence and, proof
being difficult to obtain, I would be eventually released.
That was my reason for continued denials of this crime.

I do not know any possible places where my confederates.
page_data.zh:
9 续。

虚弱无力，黄（Wong）、曾（Tsang）及其他几名男子从我身边经过。
我向他们呼救，说明我的状况，黄和其中一名不明身份的男子留在我身边，并尽可能提供协助。
到达山东路时，我感到自己愈发虚弱，为了尽可能避免被察觉，我在黄和另一名男子的帮助下，丢弃了原本要交给黄但我忘记交出的杂志；两把钥匙，一把是我家后门的，另一把是我房门的；最后还有我的长衫。

我们向南转入山东路，由于我的状况恶化，那名身穿白色西装的不明男子叫了一辆人力车，我告诉车夫去宝隆医院（Paulun Hospital），因为那是我知道的唯一一家医院，由于没有钱支付车费，我让车夫明天去医院取钱。

我从宝隆医院被转至莱斯脱医院（Lester Hospital），最后转到警务处医院。在后者住院期间，我做了两份供词，一份是在1938年6月19日，另一份是在1938年7月7日。我现在希望撤销那些供词，因为这份才是真实的。

在与吴笃宗（Woo Tuh Zung）的谈话中，他告诉我，租界当局和警方保持中立，因此如果我与他们发生纠葛，我应该否认参与或知晓该罪行，鉴于证据难以获取，我最终会被释放。这就是我持续否认这项罪行的原因。

我不知道我的同伙可能去任何地方，

page_data.en:
10 continued.

might visit or anything further regarding them other than
as already related.

I identify a long gown, blood stained, and two keys as
mine. I previously denied ownership for the reasons already
given.

Two exercise books seized at my home are mine. Two
documents one of them relating to a male Ho Ping ( 何平 ),
one, as far as I know, the property of Woo Tuh Zung as he
brought them to my home and left them there.

I do not know of any further crimes attributed to anti-
Japanese elements.

I led detectives to the Dong Shing Lao Restaurant, No.
435 Foochow Road, on the 29/8/38, where I demonstrated as
far as I knew what transpired on the night of the 12/6/38.

(Signed) Zen Ts Sung.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE ★ SPECIAL BRANCH）
page_data.zh:
10 续。

或者关于他们的任何其他情况，除了已经陈述的内容之外。

我确认一件沾有血迹的长衫和两把钥匙是我的。我之前出于已述原因否认拥有这些物品。

在我家中搜获的两本练习簿是我的。两份文件，其中一份涉及一名叫何平（Ho Ping）的男子，另一份据我所知是吴笃宗的财产，因为他把它们带到我家并留在那里。

我不知道反日分子还犯有任何其他罪行。

1938年8月29日，我带领侦探前往福州路435号东兴楼餐馆（Dong Shing Lao Restaurant），就我所知演示了1938年6月12日晚发生的情况。

（签名）Zen Ts Sung。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 ★ 特别支部）

At 10.15 a.m. 5-8-38 Pou Ts Ming (鮑子英),
Deputy Chief of Detectives of Ta Tao Police; Lee
Kwei Ching (李桂慶), Detective Sergeant of the
same Police and Wong Ying (王英), alias Wong Vung
Tsang (王鳳章), an informer, came to this office
and volunteered information regarding the assassination
at the Doong Shing Lao Restaurant, No.435 Foochow Road
on the 18-6-38 p.m.

The following is as related by Wong Vung Tsang;
about the beginning of July he was present at
a gambling den in Zau Ka Doo when he met one known
to him as Wong Seung Hei (王双喜) who had with
him a parcel wrapped in newspaper and on conversation
leading to this parcel Wong Seung Hei unwrapped same
and exposed a mauser pistol. On being questioned re
this he explained he had been present during the
assassination at the Doong Shing Lao Restaurant. He
(Wong Ying) did not do anything regarding this in-
formation until about the 15th. or 20th. July when
he was introduced to the detective, Lee Kwei Ching.
He asked Lee if he could be a detective and the latter
informed him that he would have to supply some very
good information regarding important cases. It was
then that he spoke of the information re the Doong
Shing Lao Restaurant case.

1938年8月5日上午10时15分，大陶警察局副局长鲍子英（Pou Ts Ming）、该局警探李桂庆（Lee Kwei Ching）以及线人王英（Wong Ying），别名王凤章（Wong Vung Tsang），来到本办公室，自愿提供关于1938年6月18日下午发生在福州路435号东兴楼餐馆（Doong Shing Lao Restaurant）刺杀案的情报。

以下是王凤章所述内容；七月初，他在曹家渡（Zau Ka Doo）的一家赌档时，遇到一个他认识的人，名叫王双喜（Wong Seung Hei），此人带着一个用报纸包裹的包裹，当谈话涉及到这个包裹时，王双喜拆开包裹，露出一支毛瑟手枪。当被问及此事时，他解释说他在东兴楼餐馆的刺杀案发生时在场。他（王英）直到7月15日或20日左右才就此情报采取任何行动，当时他被介绍给警探李桂庆。他问李是否可以当警探，后者告诉他必须提供一些关于重要案件的非常优质的情报。也就是在那时，他提到了关于东兴楼案件的情报。

Wong Ying alias Wong Vung Tsang further stated
that Wong Saung Hai and one other, Zung Boo Liang
(蒋步良) had been arrested on the 26-7-38 p.m. by
detectives of Chengtu Road Station and were still
detained there. He implicated both as being concerned
in the assassination aforementioned.

His manner and demeanour whilst relating the
foregoing was such that it was viewed with reserve
by detectives attached to C "8" inasmuch on being
questioned regarding the information his story varied
on important details.

However, at 12 noon he was accompanied to Chengtu
Road Station where he picked out the two males Wong Saung
Hai and Zung Boo Liang (Station numbers 675 & 672) who
were arrested on 26-7-38 p.m. in connection with Misc.
278/38 Ch. Rd.

Questioning of the two in the presence of Wong
Ying proved conclusively that his story was a fabrica-
tion. This was further borne out by results of enq-
uiries by Chengtu Road detectives who had previously
closely questioned the two regarding the assassination
as a result of a letter received by them, through Head-
quarters, from a Mr. Lien Ting.

1938年8月7日

王英，别名王凤章，进一步陈述说，王双喜（Wong Saung Hai）和另一人蒋步良（Zung Boo Liang）已于1938年7月26日下午被成都路捕房的警探逮捕，目前仍被拘留在那里。他指控这两人都参与了上述刺杀案。

他在讲述上述情况时的态度和举止引起了附属 C "8" 科的警探们的保留看法，因为在就情报进行讯问时，他的故事在重要细节上前后不一。

然而，中午12点，他被陪同前往成都路捕房，在那里他指认了两名男子王双喜和蒋步良（警局编号 675 & 672），他们因涉及杂项案件 278/38 Ch. Rd. 于1938年7月26日下午被捕。

在王英在场的情况下对这两人的讯问确凿地证明，他的故事是捏造的。成都路警探此前的调查结果也进一步证实了这一点，他们曾通过总部收到一位连廷（Lien Ting）先生的来信，据此对两人就刺杀案进行了严密讯问。

August 7, 38
1

Wong Saung Hai gave the following as having transpired;

Towards the end of June he went into a gambling den in Zau Ka Doo operated by a native of Canton. He was gambling Bah Jeu and, though a mistake in dealing cards, he (Wong) lost his bet of $10.00. He remonstrated re this but received no satisfaction. At the beginning of July he again visited the den. On his right sat Wong Yung Tsang (he did not know him as Wong Ying) whom he has known for about 10 years. On his left sat one Zee Wei Ching (徐惠善) to whom he told of the loss of $10.00 and explained that if he did not recover the money he would use the pistol which he was carrying wrapped in newspaper. He furtively showed it to Zee. (This pistol was seized when he was arrested and was the one allegedly seen by Wong Ying as a mauser). He recovered his $10.00 through the intercession of Zee who told him the den did not wish for any trouble.

About the 26th. July he and Sung Foo Liang were told by Wong Ying that the Tse Tse Police were looking for them as it had been reported they were guerillas. They eventually found out from Zee that this was not so. On the 28-7-38 they were arrested.

王双喜陈述了以下发生的情况；

六月底，他进入曹家渡一家由广东人经营的赌档。他在玩牌九（Bah Jeu），由于发牌错误，他（王）输掉了10.00美元的赌注。他对此提出抗议，但未得到满意解决。七月初，他再次光顾该赌档。坐在他右边的是王荣昌（Wong Yung Tsang）（他当时不知道他就是王英），他认识此人约10年。坐在他左边的是徐惠善（Zee Wei Ching），他向徐讲述了丢失10.00美元的事，并解释说如果要不回这笔钱，他将使用随身携带的用报纸包裹的手枪。他偷偷把手枪给徐看。（这支手枪在他被捕时被没收，也就是王英声称看到的毛瑟手枪）。通过徐的调解，他要回了10.00美元，徐告诉他赌档不希望惹麻烦。

大约7月26日，王英告诉他和宋福良（Sung Foo Liang，译注：此处原文为Sung Foo Liang，前文为Zung Boo Liang/蒋步良，依上下文应指同一人或关联人，此处按音译处理，若指前文蒋步良则可能存在拼写差异，但档案常有不一致，故保留原文发音对应汉字或注明），说法租界警察正在寻找他们，因为有人报告他们是游击队。他们最终从徐那里得知事实并非如此。7月28日，他们被捕。

August 7, 38
9/4 1

Wong Ying admitted that he had not seen the
mauser or even the pistol as stated. He asserted
however that Wong Saung Hsi had admitted being one of
those concerned in the assassination but beyond that
he had no proof whatsoever. He was unable to explain
his reason for implicating Zung Boo Liang. Wong Saung
Hsi strenuously denied all such knowledge.

It would appear that the story told by Wong Ying
was one merely to curry favour with those in charge
of the Tao Tao Police irrespective of who was charged
with the crime. It will be recalled that Mr. Lieu
Ying had just left the Doong Shing Lee Restaurant a
few minutes prior to the assassination and was possibly
the reason for Wong Ying stating he had information
regarding the case.

Wong Ying was cautioned re giving information
of a misleading nature. Pau Ta Ying and Lee Kwei Ching
were informed that no action would be taken against
the two males re this matter on the evidence to hand.

王英承认，他并未如所述那样见过毛瑟手枪，甚至没见过手枪。但他声称，王双喜（Wong Saung Hsi）承认自己是参与刺杀案的人员之一，但除此之外他没有任何证据。他无法解释指控蒋步良（Zung Boo Liang）的理由。王双喜强烈否认知晓此类情况。

看来，王英编造这个故事仅仅是为了讨好大陶警察局的负责人，而不管谁被指控犯罪。值得一提的是，刘英（Lieu Ying，音译）先生恰好在刺杀发生前几分钟离开东兴利餐馆（Doong Shing Lee Restaurant，译注：此处原文为Doong Shing Lee，前文为Doong Shing Lao/Dong Shing Lao，应为同一地点不同拼写），这可能是王英声称拥有该案情报的原因。

王英因提供误导性情报受到警告。鲍达英（Pau Ta Ying，即鲍子英）和李桂庆获悉，根据现有证据，不会就此事对两名男子采取任何行动。

The male, Chao Ts Sung (喬樹森), alias Zau Ts Sung (趙樹森) is still detained in the Police Hospital. His condition continues to improve.

The fracture the bone of his right arm is now healed. On the bullet(s) causing the fracture it/they also severed the artery and vein and these, due to the setting of the fracture, have become joined and now result in a greatly decreased quantity of blood flowing to the extremities of the arm. A further operation is considered necessary to rectify this.

Reference paragraph four on sheet 5 of diary 7:
Doctors at the Police Hospital have been enable to determine whether he has previously suffered from some nose disease or is addicted to masturbation.

He was unable to appear before the S.S.D.Court on the 27-7-38 and a further remand, on Writ of Detention, was granted until the 3-8-38 a.m.

He has continued in his denials of ownership of the blood-stained long gown and two keys or that he was in any way concerned in the murder.

On the morning of the 30-7-38 he was permitted to be removed to this office from the Police Hospital. The long gown was tried on him and the bullet holes in same corresponded with the bullet wounds on his chest and right arm. Whilst the gown appeared to be a

男子赵树森（Chao Ts Sung），别名赵树森（Zau Ts Sung，译注：原文拼音相同，中文名略有差异，依惯例统一或保留差异，此处依原文拼音对应常见译名，若为同一人则可能是笔误，照实翻译），仍被拘留在警务处医院。他的病情继续好转。

对于他这样身材的人来说有点短，但绝对不能说显然太大或太小。
在他的最后一份供词（第10A号）中，他提到他于1938年6月18日晚上8点左右离开位于法租界谭维廉路（Rue Tenant de la Tour）福贤里17号的家。从那里他走到谭维廉路，然后向北走到西爱咸斯路（Route de Selyes，译注：今永嘉路附近，旧称Route de Sieyes，此处原文拼写有误，依当时路名习惯译为西爱咸斯路或保留原文音译，考虑到上下文Route de Sieyes在后文出现，此处统一处理）的交叉口，等待22路公交车。他乘坐公交车，支付了九分钱，到达爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII，今延安东路）和浙江路，下车后步行至福建路，并沿着这条路一直走到福州路，然后向东转。他在福州路北侧（谋杀现场对面的一侧）只走了几码就受了伤。
为了核实他所述的从家到谋杀现场以这种方式旅行所需的时间，1938年7月30日上午，在法国警察的协助下，由警司福勒（D.S. Fowler）和高级警员274号（O.D.S. 274）陪同他回到家中，并在他在场的情况下讯问了主要房客陈刘氏（Zung Lieu Sz）。
她陈述说，在当晚，他在晚上7:30到8:00之间离开房子，大约

L 2190/231
2121/32 L. August 1, 38
8/3 1

half an hour later, by his mother who has since not
returned.

In company with the aforementioned detectives,
he walked from his home, along Rue Tenant de la Tour
to the intersection of Route de Sieyes. This occupied
five minutes. A wait of nine minutes was made to
compensate for the time he probably waited on the
night in question, a route 22 motor bus was then followed
from that point to Avenue Edward VII and Chekiang Road.
This occupied exactly twenty minutes.

From this place the party walked along Avenue
Edward VII to Fokien Road, along the latter to Foochow
Road and then turned East and after about 40 yards came
opposite the Dong Shing Leu Restaurant, 435 Foochow Road.
The time occupied was fourteen minutes.

Therefore, from leaving his home to the scene of
the murder, done in exactly the same manner in which
he alleges he did, took a total of fourty eight minutes
only whereas, according to him, it required from 8.30 p.m
to 9.50 p.m., a total of 80 minutes.

If, as he verbally stated during the experiment,
he left his home at 8.30 p.m. and passed the "Ruby Queen"
clock at the intersection of Yu Ya Ching Road and Avenue
Edward VII when it showed 9 p.m., he would have been
outside the scene of the murder at about twenty minutes
past nine. He thus has to explain the reason for his

半小时后，他的母亲跟随其后，此后未归。

在上述警探的陪同下，他从家出发，沿着谭维廉路走到西爱咸斯路（Route de Sieyes）的交叉口。这花了五分钟。为了补偿他在当晚可能等待的时间，等待了九分钟，然后从该点跟随一辆22路公交车到爱多亚路和浙江路。这正好花了二十分钟。

从这个地方，一行人沿着爱多亚路走到福建路，沿后者走到福州路，然后向东转，走了大约40码后，来到福州路435号东兴楼餐馆（Dong Shing Leu Restaurant）对面。所花时间为十四分钟。

因此，从他离家到谋杀现场，完全按照他声称的方式进行，总共只花了四十八分钟，而据他说，这需要从晚上8:30到9:50，总共80分钟。

如果像他在实验过程中口头陈述的那样，他于晚上8:30离开家，并在余雅清路（Yu Ya Ching Road，译注：今淮海中路一段旧称，或为Route Henri Riviere等，此处依音译）和爱多亚路的交叉口经过“Ruby Queen”钟表店时显示为晚上9点，那么他将在九点二十分左右出现在谋杀现场外。因此，他必须解释他的

presence in the vicinity for half an hour which is
not accounted for. He received his injuries at about
9.50 p.m.

It is to be noted that at the time of the experi-
ment he was in a weakened condition due to hospitalisa-
tion therefore the times stated would approximate those
of a healthy person who might, at periods, idle along.

In view of the fact he is at present held on a
Writ of Detention until the 2/8/38 a.m., this file is
submitted for consideration re further action regard-
ing whether or not the application for his detention
be cancelled and he be then held under the Proclamation
dated July 19th. 1938 or a charge be preferred against
him in the S.S.D.Court.

这些文件是他的财产，称其中一些书籍可能属于他的弟弟赵春弟（au Tsung Dien），26岁，扬州人，曾在南京陆军学校就读，后任吴淞上海警备司令部侦缉，在中国军队从上海地区撤退时离开上海，而他（au Tsung）将这些书从扬州家中带了出来。

其他书籍和文件可能属于吴德仁（Foo Tuh ung），约30岁，湖北人，住在金阿路（Jin a Road）某不知名地址。此人曾是扬州的教师，曾偶尔到他（au Tsung）位于拉荷路福星里（Foo Shing Lee）17号的家中拜访，有时利用他（au Tsung）房间里的桌子写信等。

持有这些文件及其性质倾向于增加针对 Au Tsung 涉嫌此罪行的间接证据，但由于他被拘押在警察医院，调查受到阻碍，他不太可能出席1938年7月12日的庭审。

The following is the statement of C.P.C. 2574.
native of ____________________ taken by H.E. Bennett, D.I.
at Louza Stn. on the 21-6-38. and interpreted by Clark Faung.

During the evening of 18-6-38, I was detailed for duty
at the "Standard" newspaper offices, 436 Foochow Road, which
premises are opposite the Deong Shing Leu Restaurant, Foochow
Road. C.P.C.s 1403 and 1562 C.D.S. 315 were on duty together
with me.

We were standing in front of these offices at about 9.50 pm
on the 18-6-38, when at this time I heard the sound of a lot of
reports, all at the same time, and thinking that these were
shots fired from above me I pulled out and loaded my pistol and
stood at entrance doorway to these offices facing the doorway.
Whilst C.D.S. 315 and C.P.C. 1562 called the office coolie to
open the iron gates and after the coolie had opened the gateway
C.D.S. 315 and C.P.C. 1562 went inside and I together with
C.P.C. 1403 stood outside.

I did not see any persons run from the Deong Shing Leu
restaurant due to the large crowd of people on the roadway.

After calling the coolie to open the door of the offices,
the door was opened in about one minute.

Whilst I was standing on the pavement outside the "Standard"
offices, after I had heard the reports of the shots which appeared
to be all fired together I did not hear any shot which appeared
to have been fired on the roadway.

I am definite that I did not hear any shot fired from the
roadway, for all the shots I heard appeared to be all together
as if fired from a machine gun or a burst of fire crackers and
were fired at the same period. I did not hear any shot fired
after this burst.

（签名：Bennett）

籍贯 ___，由督察 H.E. Bennett 于1938年6月21日在老闸捕房录取，由 Clark Faung 传译。

1938年6月18日晚，我被派往福州路436号《标准报》（Standard）报社执勤，该处位于福州路东兴楼餐厅对面。华捕1403号、1562号及印捕315号与我一同执勤。

1938年6月18日晚约9点50分，我们正站在这些办公室门前，此时我听到许多响声，同时发出，我以为这些是从我上方射出的枪声，便拔出手枪上膛，站在办公室入口处，面向门口。与此同时，印捕315号和华捕1562号叫办公室的茶房打开铁门，茶房打开大门后，印捕315号和华捕1562号进入室内，我与华捕1403号留在外面。

由于路上人群拥挤，我没有看到有人从东兴楼餐厅跑出来。

叫茶房打开办公室门后，大约过了一分钟门才打开。

当我站在《标准报》社门外的人行道上时，在我听到似乎是一齐发出的枪声后，我没有听到任何看似在马路上发射的枪声。

我确信没有听到马路上有任何枪声，因为我听到的所有枪声似乎都是一起发出的，就像机枪射击或一串鞭炮声，并且是在同一时刻发射的。在这阵声响之后，我没有听到任何枪声。

（签名：Bennett）

It stopped opposite the Standard Oil Company gate.
Two men got out and went into the Standard Oil Company office.
I immediately reported this to the Police Station by telephone.
About 5 minutes later two detectives arrived at the scene.
They went into the Standard Oil Company office.
About 1 or 2 minutes after they had gone out of the
Standard Oil Company, the Reserve Units and the detectives arrived
at the scene to make enquiries. As my duty was to protect the
Standard Oil Company, I was afraid to leave the spot. I do
not know anything further than the above.

My name is Yao Ming Teh, age 58, Shanghai, ex/Second
Department Officer of Land Commission at Kirin, residing at 320
Route Frelupt, ...

After my graduation from the Agricultural Univer-
sity of Peking I proceeded to Peiping in 1905 and worked under
Yen Fu Hai (袁古凱) then as a tax commissioner of Heung Loong
Tang (黑龍江). After 4 years I was again ordered to work as
a chief officer of General Affairs of Tai Yar Heng (通太衡)
Kirin Province.

In 1913 I came to Shanghai and resided at 7 Zau Char
Road (肇嘉路), Zhipe City. Then I went to Canton in 1915
and was appointed as a high officer of Canton Custom House
for 3 years. Coming back from Canton in 1918 and I was doing
land business. On the outbreak of Sino-Japanese conflict in
1932 my business was bad and I found myself without work. On
20-1-38 the deceased Ming Chi Te (任濟德) alias Ming Pao An
(明保安) came to my home for friendly visit (his father was my
co worker when in Kirin). (The deceased was formerly a clerk
of Railway Station in Kirin). The deceased came to Shanghai
by order of Japanese military to organize certain officers
after the occupation of Shanghai. He asked me to help him
because I knew the place better. The Japanese instructed him
to organize the Land Bureau Office and he would be the future
head officer, whilst it was promised that I would be the
departmental head of the 2nd department of that 'Land Bureau'.

On 18-6-38 at 4 p.m. I received an invitation card
from him to dine at Doong Shing Lee (同興樓) restaurant.

我叫姚明德，58岁，上海人，前吉林省土地委员会第二科官员，现居费伦路（Route Frelupt）320号……

我于北京农业大学毕业后，于1905年前往北平，在袁古凱（Yen Fu Hai，音译）手下工作，当时他任黑龙江（Heung Loong Tang）税务专员。四年后，我又奉命担任吉林省通太衡（Tai Yar Heng，音译）总务科长。

1913年我来到上海，居住在闸北市肇嘉路（Zau Char Road）7号。随后我于1915年前往广州，被任命为广州海关高级官员，任期三年。1918年从广州回来后，我从事地产业务。1932年中日冲突爆发时，我的生意不景气，发现自己失业了。1938年1月20日，死者任濟德（Ming Chi Te），又名明保安（Ming Pao An），来我家友好拜访（其父是我在吉林时的同事）。（死者原为吉林火车站职员）。死者奉日军命令，在上海沦陷后组织某些官员。因为他更熟悉当地情况，他请求我协助。日本人指示他组织土地局办公室，他将担任未来的局长，同时承诺我将担任该“土地局”第二科的科长。

1938年6月18日下午4点，我收到他的请柬，邀请我在同興樓（Doong Shing Lee）餐厅用餐。

Municipal Police Hospital,
P.H.D., S.M.C,

June 29th, 1938.

To
Inspector in Charge,
Louza Station,
S. M. Police.

Dear Sir,

Re: Prisoner Zau Tsu Sung.

This is to certify that Prisoner Zau Tsu Sung
admitted to the Hospital on the 19th instant is suffer-
ing from bullet wounds of the right arm, chest and left
wrist. There are four wounds of the arm with the
underlying bone fractured. These were caused by two
shots. The two wounds of the right side of the
chest are superficial and connected by a track which
is in direct alignment with one of the tracks of the
arm and therefore appear to be produced by the same
missile. The wounds of the wrist are superficial
and could have been caused by one of the bullets that
wounded the arm.

From the foregoing I am of the opinion that
the wounds though numerous (eight) were the result of
at most three bullets (probably two). I have also
examined the garment brought here on the 22nd. The
position of the holes and blood stains correspond
exactly with the position of the wounds.

Yours faithfully
Sgd : J.J. Kwoh.
Medical Officer.

1938年6月29日。

致
督察长，
老闸捕房，
上海公共租界警务处。

尊敬的先生：

关于：囚犯赵树松（Zau Tsu Sung）。

兹证明囚犯赵树松于本月19日入院，患有右臂、胸部和左手腕枪伤。手臂上有四处伤口， underlying bone（底层骨骼）骨折。这些伤口是由两发子弹造成的。右侧胸部的两处伤口较浅，由一条弹道相连，该弹道与手臂的一条弹道直接对齐，因此似乎是由同一投射物造成的。手腕处的伤口较浅，可能是由击中手臂的其中一颗子弹造成的。

综上所述，我认为虽然伤口众多（八处），但最多是由三颗子弹（可能为两颗）造成的。我还检查了于22日送来的衣物。破洞和血迹的位置与伤口位置完全对应。

此致
敬礼
签署：J.J. Kwoh。
医务官。

Translation of a document found at the home of
Zau Ts-sung (      ), 17 Foo Hsin Li, Rue Ratard, F.C.
at          June 19, 1938.

Report - June 18th.

Re Application for a loan of 20 which
will be given to Ho Ping (何平) to
defray expenses incurred in proceeding
from Shanghai to Hankow.

Yesterday afternoon, Ho Ping (何平),
Kuo Tseng-kwong (郭增光), etc. were arrested
by the Settlement Police. I have received word
of their arrest through Liu Yung-tei (刘永堤).
Indeed you are very kind to me; you decide
not to punish Ho Ping for his mistake, but
instruct him to leave Shanghai within five days.
On receiving your instructions, I at once notified
Ho Ping to this effect and ordered him to comply
with the instruction within the specified time.
Ho Ping is very grateful to you.

With reference to his statement made
at the Police Station, he cried and stated that
he could find no way to argue about it. He
strongly denied that he was a member of the Asia
Rehabilitation Society. He declared that he
would obey Mr. Zao's (曹) order to the full
extent, but requested financial aid in order to enable
him to proceed to Hankow and continue the anti-
Japanese movement as a means to wipe off his disgrace.

Although Ho Ping has been in Shanghai for
sometime, he has had no relatives nor any intimate
friends; consequently although he wishes to obey
the order, it is impossible for him to take his
departure without money.

Record shows that Ho Ping has been very
energetic in national salvation work during the past

（左侧手写批注：This appears peculiar?）

A
1938年6月19日在法租界辣斐德路福新里17号
赵祖松 (      ) 家中发现的一份文件的
译文。

报告 - 6月18日。

关于申请借款20元，该款项
将给予何平 (何平)，以支付其从
上海前往汉口的费用。

昨日下午，何平 (何平)、
郭增光 (郭增光) 等人被租界警察逮捕。
我通过刘永堤 (刘永堤) 收到了他们
被捕的消息。您确实对我非常关照；您决定
不因何平的错误而惩罚他，而是
指令他在五天内离开上海。
收到您的指令后，我立即通知
何平此事，并命令他在规定期限内
遵守指令。何平对您非常感激。

关于他在捕房所作的陈述，
他哭诉并表示无法对此进行辩驳。他
强烈否认自己是“亚洲复兴社”的成员。他声明
他将完全服从曹先生 (曹) 的命令，但请求
经济援助，以便他能前往汉口，继续从事反
日活动，以此作为洗刷耻辱的手段。

虽然何平在上海已有一段时间，
但他没有亲属，也没有亲密的朋友；因此，尽管他希望
服从命令，但没有钱他不可能离开。

记录显示，何平在过去一直非常
积极地从事救国工作

（左侧手写批注：这看起来很奇怪？）

page_data.en:
and his unpardonable mistake of this time is entirely
due to his failure to maintain secrecy as well as his
false accusations and statements.

Thanks to your consideration, he is allowed
to redeem his wrong by going away from Shanghai.
I, being a friend of his, can not bear to look that
he leaves Shanghai without any money. Consequently
I take the liberty to request you to advance me $20
in order to enable me to give him something so
that he may proceed to Hankow. I trust you will
approve my request in view of the circumstances.
I promise to refund the loan in four installments which
may be deducted from my allowance during the coming
four months.

Yours credently,
Hueng Pih (汪精).
page_data.zh:
而他这次不可原谅的错误完全是
由于他未能保守秘密以及他的虚假指控和陈述所致。

感谢您的体谅，允许他通过离开上海来
赎罪。我作为他的朋友，不忍心看他
身无分文地离开上海。因此，我冒昧请求
您预支给我20美元，以便我能给他一些钱，
使他能够前往汉口。鉴于上述情况，我相信您会
批准我的请求。我承诺分四期偿还这笔贷款，
可从未来四个月的津贴中扣除。

此致，
汪精 (Hueng Pih)。

Zau Ts Sung, aged 30, s/unemployed, native
〔此处转录不清〕
17 Foo hsin rd, Sze set road, F.C.
Originally I lived in the city of Yangchow at Yeun
〔此处转录不清〕
and was the owner of the said cloth making store
for a period of seven years.
On the 24/11/47 my store in native place was destroyed
by the communist forces and on the same
day I escaped to the possession of Yangchow. I then escaped
from that city with my mother and regarding to my wife and
father's whereabouts at present is unknown to me.
On arrival at Shanghai we first resided at a certain
lodging house in F.C. and later we took one room in the house
No. 17 Foo Hsin Rd.
Between May and June 5th this year I was often
attacked by illness and therefore my body is quite weak now.
At 8.30 p.m. yesterday (10/8/48) I took bus and alighted at
Tung Yan Jao near Ave, Edward VII on the way to Fokien Road
to buy some nourishments. As walking on Fokien Road and turned
to Foochow to find bookstore with the intent to buy a
fountainpen. When I was walking on Foochow road east of Doong
Hsin Lai I heard heavy sound of boots-step from my back and
I turned and I saw one foreigndressed male armed with mauser
pistol. I unintentionally shouted out "Robber" and I then proc
ed to east. At that time I heard the sound of shooting and
many people ran to eastward on Foochow Road. When I proceeded
to pass over about ten shops' distance I observed that my

赵祖松。

投诉日期 1948年9月10日

赵祖松，30岁，职业/无业，籍贯
〔此处转录不清〕
法租界四明路福新路17号。
我原住在扬州城叶云
〔此处转录不清〕
并拥有上述布店七年之久。
1947年11月24日，我家乡的店铺被共产党军队摧毁，同日
我逃往扬州辖区。随后我与母亲一起逃离该城市，至于我妻子和
父亲目前的下落，我尚不知情。
抵达上海后，我们最初居住在法租界的一家
旅馆，后来我们在福新路17号的房子里租了一间房间。
今年5月至6月5日期间，我经常患病，因此现在身体相当虚弱。
昨晚（1948年8月10日）8点30分，我乘公共汽车，在前往福建路
购买营养品的途中，于爱多亚路附近的东延角下车。当我走在福建路上并转向
福州路寻找书店打算购买一支钢笔时。当我走在福州路东段，经过同兴来以东时，
我听到身后传来沉重的皮靴声，我转身看到一名身穿西式服装的男子，手持毛瑟手枪。
我不由自主地大喊“强盗”，然后向东跑去。当时我听到枪声，
许多人在福州路上向东奔跑。当我跑了大约十家店铺的距离时，我发现我的

page_data.en:
forearm was wounded and I could not walk any more. One
foreign dressed male who was near by me told me to hire
a ricksha to hospital. I immediately took a ricksha and went to
St. Paul's Hospital and they again sent me to the better Chinese
Hospital for cure. This is my true statement.

〔此处转录不清〕

(Any outstanding or peculiar feature to be
communicated on by investigating officer). | At 9.30.p.m. 18-6-38, a telephone message
was received at Louza Station from C...C.3369,
Traffic Post Fokien and Foochow Roads Corner
reporting a shooting affray having occurred in the
Doong Shing Lar (同興樓) Restaurant, 435 Foochow
Road.

Inspector Chamberlain, Detective Inspector
Bennett, Inspector Cash and all available men
immediately attended, including members of the
Reserve Unit Search Party under Sub Inspector
Campbell who were at this time standing by in Louza
Station, but upon arrival it was found that the
persons responsible for the shooting had escaped.
despite a search of the immediate vicinity by
members of the Reserve Unit and Louza Station staff,
no trace of these persons could be found.

D.I. Bennett, D.S. MacLennan enquiries, for
immediately upon entry into the upstairs room of the
restaurant a male Mr. Hing Chi Tz (任序) and
female Chinese (Sing Song girl) were found to be
lying on the floor, apparently dead, whilst two
other male Chinese, Yao Ming Tuh (姚明達) and Lau
Kou Myeh (趙國業) (a Chinese fiddle player) were
found to be suffering from bullet wounds.

All were immediately conveyed to the
Lester Chinese Hospital by the Fire Brigade
Ambulance.

Further enquiries ascertained that during
the evening of Saturday, 18-6-38, a party was given
in the Doong Shing Lar Restaurant, 435 Foochow Road. |

该电话来自福建路与福州路路口的交通岗，报告称福州路435号
同兴楼餐馆发生枪击事件。

张伯伦巡官、贝内特侦探巡官、卡什巡官及所有可用警力
立即赶赴现场，包括由坎贝尔副巡官率领的后备队搜查组成员，
当时他们正在老闸捕房待命，但到达后发现开枪责任人已经逃脱。
尽管后备组成员和老闸捕房人员对附近区域进行了搜查，
但未发现这些人的踪迹。

贝内特侦探巡官、麦克莱南侦探警探立即展开调查，
进入餐馆楼上房间后，发现一名华人男子任序 (Hing Chi Tz) 和
一名华人女子（歌女）躺在地板上，显然已死亡，同时发现另外两名
华人男子姚明达 (Yao Ming Tuh) 和赵国业 (Lau Kou Myeh)（一名中国胡琴师）
遭受枪伤。

所有人随即由消防队救护车送往仁济医院。

进一步调查查明，1938年6月18日星期六晚间，
福州路435号同兴楼餐馆举行了一场聚会。 |

by 5 men, all of whom were armed with pistols, who after
ascending the stairs, three men being ahead who intimidat-
ed the waiters and accountant at the desk and large room
at the head of the stairs, proceeding along the passageway
leading to the room occupied by the members of the
dinner party, when they immediately opened fire at party
sitting at these tables, at least 18 shots being fired
by these men who had entered into the dining room, who
then immediately decamped via point of entry, two
military type Mauser automatic pistols being discarded
by them in the large room at the head of the stairs as
they made good their escape, no attempt being made to
follow them.

The following persons in this room were found to
be suffering from bullet wounds:-

(1) Mr. Ning Chi Ts, member of the Dr. Tao Government,
(Dead upon arrival at Hospital).

(2) Lau Sung Hoong (柳松红) age 17, native of Soochow,
Sing Song girl, living, House 10, Lane 258, Yuyuan
Road, (Dead upon arrival at Hospital).

(3) Mr. Yao Ming Tuh, member of the Dr. Tao Government,
(compound fracture of right femur, (Detained in

This man was subsequently transferred to the Lester Chinese Hospital where he was detained, bullet wound of right arm, ascertained to be one Zhu Ts Sung (赵树生) aged 30, Yangchow, living 17 Foh Ching Young (福庆坊) Rue la Tour, French Concession, states he was walking on Foochow Road in the vicinity of this restaurant, when he noticed a male Chinese run across the road from the restaurant, this man having a long pistol in his hand, and he upon seeing this man with a pistol called out "Robber", whereupon this man fired one shot at him which struck him in the arm, he then obtaining a public ricksha and conveyed to Paulun Hospital by ricksha Licence No.3069, puller, Liu Ryoh Ryung (刘玉荣).

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Wong Tsung Ching, 45.
native of _________________ taken by me D.I. Bennett.
at house No. ______ on the 12-5-36 and interpreted by Chen Tsung.

My name is Wong Tsung Ching (王仲琴), I am at present
living at No. 8 Pao Yue Lee (宝裕里), Avenue Foch. I was
previously with the Jesuit Missionaries at Sikawei, but at
present I am employed by the Local Teh Pao Government in the Land
Bureau.

On Saturday evening, Mr. Yen Chi Ss
(任济时) gave a dinner party to which a number of Chinese
officials of the Land Bureau attended and also some Japanese
officials of the Japanese Consular Home Affairs
Military Attache.

The party was held at the Doong Kee Laol (同兴楼)
Restaurant, 475 Nanking Road and this party was to be given.
We commenced dinner at about 7.30 p.m. after all the
guests had assembled.

During the progress of the dinner Mr. Yen Chi Ss (任济时)
called a number of Sing Song Girls to the tables, then at about
9 p.m. two men entered the dinner room. I suddenly heard
a number of shots fired which attracted my attention to these
men.

These shots appeared to be fired at Mr. Yen Chi Ss (任济时)
and I dropped to the ground taking cover under the table.
I was not sitting at the table with Mr. Yen Chi Ss (任济时)

以下为王仲琴（Wong Tsung Ching），45岁之供词，
籍贯 ___，由本人警探长贝内特（D.I. Bennett）
于1936年5月12日在 ______ 号住宅录取，并由陈宗（Chen Tsung）翻译。

我叫王仲琴（Wong Tsung Ching），目前住霞飞路宝裕里8号。我以前在徐家汇耶稣会传教团工作，但目前受雇于本地德保政府土地局。

周六晚上，任济时（Yen Chi Ss）先生举办晚宴，土地局的多名中国官员以及日本领事馆家务军事武官处的一些日本官员出席了宴会。

宴会在南京路475号的同兴楼（Doong Kee Laol）餐馆举行，宴会即将开始。
所有客人到齐后，我们于晚上7点30分左右开始用餐。

晚宴进行中，任济时（Yen Chi Ss）先生叫了几名歌女到桌旁助兴，随后约在晚上9点，两名男子进入餐厅。我突然听到几声枪响，这引起了我的注意，我看到了这些人。

这些枪似乎是朝任济时（Yen Chi Ss）先生开的，我趴在地上，躲在桌子底下避险。我当时并没有和任济时（Yen Chi Ss）先生坐在同一张桌子旁

Louza 'tn.    18/6/38    ......342
translated
//////    by one Chia-tsi ng

Zau Kuo Ngoeh ( 趙國玉 ) .    I am a native of
Tientsin, aged 34, married, residing upstairs of the Yu
Changge Shop, Yuhua Road.    I am a Chinese fiddle
player.    At 9.30 p.m. June 18, 1938, Miss Zau Sung
( 双红 ), 10 Yuhua Road, came to me and
asked me to accompany her to call on her aunt at the Loong
Shing Restaurant, 400 Connaught Road.    On arrival, I
saw there were two tables in the hall, with 7-8 Chinese
males and 7-8 Japanese sitting around, later the Japanese
left the dinner party.    The others all stood up bidding
farewell to the Japanese.    About 10 minutes after the
departure of the Japanese, whilst I was playing my fiddle,
facing towards the window, and Miss Zau Sung Hung ( shot
dead ) was singing, three male Chinese, each with a Mauser
pistol, fired into the hall some twenty shots.    They
immediately made their escape.    I was injured and fell
underneath the table.    I was later conveyed to the Lester
Chinese Hospital by ambulance.    After dressing, I was
discharged.

The description of the persons escaping after
the shooting is as follows :-
1. One seemed to wear a black long gown, holding two Mauser
pistols.
2. Two seemed to wear black jackets, each with a pistol or
Mauser pistol.

Zau Kuo Ngoeh ( cross marked )

赵国玉（Zau Kuo Ngoeh）。
天津
Louza 'tn.    1938年6月18日     ____ 342
翻译
//////    由 Chia-tsi ng 翻译

赵国玉（Zau Kuo Ngoeh）。 我是天津人，34岁，已婚，住雨花路裕昌阁商店楼上。 我是一名中国胡琴师。 1938年6月18日晚上9点30分，雨花路10号的赵双红（Zau Sung）小姐来找我，请我陪她去康纳脱路（Connaught Road）400号的龙兴餐馆拜访她的阿姨。 到达后，我看到大厅里有两张桌子，周围坐着七八名中国男性和七八名日本人，后来日本人离开了晚宴。 其他人都站起来向日本人道别。 日本人离开约10分钟后，当我面向窗户拉胡琴，赵双红（被枪杀）在唱歌时，三名中国男子各持一支毛瑟手枪，向大厅开了约二十枪。 他们立即逃窜。 我受伤后倒在桌子底下。 后来我被救护车送往莱斯中国医院。 包扎后，我出院了。

枪击后逃逸人员的描述如下：-
1. 一人似乎身穿黑色长衫，手持两支毛瑟手枪。
2. 两人似乎身穿黑色夹克，各持一把手枪或毛瑟手枪。

赵国玉（画十字标记）

Liang Soo Ying (〔此处转录不清〕), age 18,
residing at 18 Hung Shing Li, Sinza Road,
Soochow, -- C.D.C.161

Lou-a Station 18-6-38

My name is Liang Soo Ying. I am a native of
Soochow, age 18, residing at 18 Hung Shing Li, Sinza Road.
In September, 1937, through the recommendation of
my friend named Yang Soo Tseng, I joined the Dao Dao Girl
Guide Agency, 9 Tsing Jing Fang, Chekiang Road.
At 8.20.p.m. 18-6-38, a telephone call was received
at the agency from a waiter of the Deong Shing Lur Restaurant,
435 Foochow Road, stating that a patron at the restaurant
wanted two girl guides. I and another girl named Tseh Chun
took a ricksha to the Deong Shing Lur Restaurant, Foochow
Road. On arrival, I saw two tables in the hall, accompanied
by a number of Chinese with 7-8 Japanese sitting beside.
I sat down beside a Chinese, aged about 40 (the man injured).
About one hour afterwards, I left my seat and went to
veranda. Five minutes later, I heard reports of gun shots
in the hall, and I intended to return to the hall to see
what had happened. At this moment, I received wounds on my
right arm, and fell to the floor on the veranda. After two or
〔签名〕three minutes, when the shooting had over, I saw two persons
shot and lying on the floor. I did not see the assailant.
I then hurried back and reported the occurrence to the
proprietor of the Agency, named Sung, who sent me by motor
car to the Lester Chinese Hospital for treatment. After
dressing, I was accompanied by detectives to the Police
Station. My wounds are not serious.

The above is my true statement.

Signed: Liang Soo Ying.

4

梁秀英（〔此处转录不清〕），18岁，
住苏州新闸路宏兴里18号，-- C.D.C.161

老闸捕房 1938年6月18日

我叫梁秀英。我是苏州人，18岁，住在新闸路宏兴里18号。
1937年9月，经我的朋友杨秀增推荐，我加入了位于浙江路清静坊9号的道道女子向导社。
1938年6月18日晚上8点20分，向导社接到福州路435号同兴楼餐厅一名侍者的电话，称该餐厅有一位顾客需要两名女子向导。我和另一名名叫谢春的女孩乘人力车前往福州路的同兴楼餐厅。到达后，我看见大厅里有两张桌子，旁边陪着一些中国人，还有7-8名日本人坐在旁边。我坐在一位约40岁的中国人（受伤男子）旁边。大约一小时后，我离开座位走到阳台。五分钟后，我听到大厅里有枪声，我打算回到大厅看看发生了什么事。就在这时，我的右臂受伤，倒在阳台的地板上。过了两三分
〔签名〕钟，枪声停止后，我看见两个人中枪躺在地板上。我没有看见袭击者。
随后我急忙回去向向导社老板宋某报告此事，他派汽车送我去莱斯中国医院治疗。包扎伤口后，由侦探陪同前往警察局。我的伤势不重。

以上是我的真实陈述。

签名：梁秀英。

page_data.en:
Hsu Hwei-tien ( 許惠田 )
Shantung                                D.S. McKnown.
House 3tn.          18/6/38             C.D.I. 9th Tse-liang.

My name is Hsu Hwei-tien, native of Shantung,
age 30, and I have been a waiter of the Doong Shing Bar
Restaurant, 435 Foochow Road, for six years.
At 5 p.m. 18/6/38 when I was working in the
General Hall, 1st floor, I saw a Chinese, who was of stout
build, wearing foreign dress sitting at a square table.
I recognize this gentleman because he has been at the
restaurant in the past, although I do not know his name.
I then went downstairs for food, and when I
returned upstairs, I saw then that more persons, including
two Japanese, had arrived and sat at the same table.
Although I could not see the exact number of persons, I
think that there were about six persons sitting around the
table. About 9.40 p.m. I saw they had finished the food,
and began to put on their coats. Then one of the persons
instructed one of the waiters named Mao Hsuch-ming ( 毛學明 )
to hire a car from the Ford Hire Garage to go to Hongkew.
The accountant of the Restaurant then returned and stated
that the Ford Hire Garage refused to send car to Hongkew
because the Garage had no passes, whereupon this person
stated that it was only necessary for the car to take them
to the Garden Bridge. The accountant then came out from the
hall and returned to his desk, but before he could telephone
the Garage again, I saw three Chinese coming up the stairs;
they were all armed with pistols. The sight of weapons
stunned me, and I could only recollect that they were all
dressed in foreign clothing. I could not recognize their
page_data.zh:
许惠田 ( 許惠田 )
山东                                D.S. McKnown.
3tn号房屋          1938年6月18日             C.D.I. 第九队 谢良。

我叫许惠田，山东人，
30岁，我在福州路435号同兴酒吧餐厅当侍者已有六年。
1938年6月18日下午5点，当我在一楼大厅工作时，我看见一个身材魁梧、穿着西装的中国人坐在一张方桌旁。我认出这位先生，因为他以前来过这家餐厅，虽然我不知道他的名字。
然后我下楼去吃饭，当我回到楼上时，我看到更多的人，包括两名日本人，已经到来并坐在同一张桌子旁。虽然我看不到确切的人数，但我认为大约有六个人围坐在桌旁。晚上9点40分左右，我看到他们吃完了饭，开始穿上外套。然后其中一人指示一名名叫毛学明 ( 毛學明 ) 的侍者去福特租车行叫一辆车去虹口。餐厅的会计随后回来说，福特租车行拒绝派车去虹口，因为车行没有通行证，于是此人表示只需让车把他们送到外白渡桥即可。会计随后从大厅出来回到他的办公桌前，但在他再次给车行打电话之前，我看见三个中国人走上楼梯；他们都带着手枪。看到武器使我惊呆了，我只记得他们都穿着西装。我无法辨认他们的

page_data.en:
- 2 -

faces and I do not think that I could identify them if I
met them again. These three persons then pointed their
pistols at all the waiters and the accountant standing by
the side of the desk, and shouted "Don't move", whereupon
they entered the hall. I was so frightened that I at
once stooped down and managed to escape into a small room,
but not before I saw two others, also armed, coming
upstairs, and shouting "Don't move." In the meantime,
I heard the reports of pistol firing inside. I then
remained in the small room and did not see anything that
happened afterwards until it was very quiet outside, when
I came out and the accountant rang up the Police.

Russell
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

面孔，我想如果我再见到他们，我也认不出来。这三个人随后用枪指着所有侍者和站在办公桌旁的会计，大喊“不许动”，随即他们进入大厅。我非常害怕，立刻蹲下身子，设法逃进一个小房间，但在我看到另外两个也带着武器的人走上楼梯并大喊“不许动”之前。与此同时，我听到里面传来手枪射击的声音。然后我待在小房间里，直到外面非常安静时才出来，期间没有看到后来发生的任何事情，出来后会计报了警。

Russell
