Mao Yeh Ming (毛学明)
Yangtchow
16/6/30
Clerk. Song Chia-tsing

My name is Mao Yeh Ming (毛学明). I am a
waiter No.5 employed by the Doong Hing Bar Restaurant,
438 Soochow Road. At about 9.45 p.m. to-day, June 16,
while I was working in the hall on the 1st floor of
the restaurant, I heard the reports of gun shots. I
then looked towards the place, where the sounds came
from, and I saw a Chinese, with a pistol in one of his
hands, standing in the corridor leading to the hall.
The appearance of the man I cannot remember, because
I was very frightened at that time. I immediately ran
to the rear part of the hall and hid underneath a table.
After about ten minutes, I came out, when I saw a male
Chinese, aged about 30, and a girl from a singsong house,
shot and lying on the floor of the hall. The assailant
had already gone.

The man who was shot attended the Restaurant
at about 7 p.m. 16/6/30 and joined a dinner party
consisting of about 16 persons, including 6 or 7 Japanese.
I had not seen him attending the restaurant on previous
occasions.

About fifteen minutes after the incident, a
party of Police arrived, and the persons shot were
removed by an ambulance.
page_data.zh:
毛叶明 (毛学明)
扬州
1930年6月16日
职员。宋嘉廷

我叫毛叶明 (毛学明)。我是苏州路438号同兴酒吧餐厅雇佣的5号侍者。今天，6月16日，晚上9点45分左右，当我在餐厅一楼大厅工作时，我听到了枪声。我随即朝声音传来的地方看去，看见一个中国人，手里拿着一把手枪，站在通往大厅的走廊里。我不记得那个人的相貌，因为当时我非常害怕。我立刻跑到大厅的后部，躲在一张桌子底下。大约十分钟后，我出来时，看见一个约30岁的中国男子和一个妓女中枪躺在大厅的地板上。袭击者已经离开。

被枪击的男子于1930年6月16日晚上7点左右来到餐厅，参加了一个由约16人组成的晚宴，其中包括6或7名日本人。我以前没见过他来这家餐厅。

事发后约十五分钟，一队警察到达，伤者由救护车运走。

page_data.en:
Zau Nyi Nan (赵尼南), age 19,
residing at No.10 (2nd alleyway) of Foh Ziang Li, Kwangse Road,
Soochow,
Louza Station        18-6-38        -------

: 9.p.m. 18-6-38, one named Yao sent for me. I then
accompanied by Zau Song Hung, took a ricsha and proceeded to
Room No.2 of the Doon Shing Lur Restaurant, 435 Foochow Road,
On arriving at the restaurant, I saw two round tables, with more
then 10 persons sitting around. I took a seat at one of the
tables in the East, besides my patron named Nyung. About 15
minutes later, I heard cracking noise, occuring behind me.
I turned my head backwards and I saw a man wearing black long
gown, with a pistol in his hand, shooting towards the table at
the West. At this moment, the man also shot towards the table
at the East. I did not note the appearance of the man clearly.
I immediately ran to the door, and hid myself in another room.
Five minutes later, I came out, when I saw others did so. I
was later taken to the Police Station.

Signed and cross marked: Zau Nyi Nan.
page_data.zh:
赵尼南 (赵尼南)，19岁，
住苏州广西路福祥里10号（第二弄堂），
老闸捕房        1938年6月18日        -------

：1938年6月18日晚上9点，一个叫姚的人叫我。随后我在赵松洪的陪同下，乘人力车前往福州路435号同兴楼餐厅的2号房间。到达餐厅后，我看见两张圆桌，周围坐着10多人。我在东边的一张桌子旁坐下，旁边是我的顾客杨某。大约15分钟后，我听到身后传来爆裂声。我回过头，看见一个穿着黑色长袍的男人，手里拿着手枪，向西边的桌子射击。就在这时，那个人也向东边的桌子射击。我没有看清那个人的相貌。我立刻跑到门口，把自己藏在另一个房间里。五分钟后，我看见其他人也这样做，我便出来了。后来我被带到警察局。

签名并画十字标记：赵尼南。

page_data.en:
Tsang Li Li (張莉莉)
Shanghai                                        J.S. Museum.
Louza Stn.           18/6/38                     C.D.I. 9th Tse-liang

My name is Tsang Li Li, aged 19, native of
Shanghai. I reside at 34 Doong Zer Li (同春里),
Chengtu Road. I am a dancing girl at the Tu Zeng (都城)
Dancing Hall, Rue Brenier de Montmorand. At 9 p.m.
June 18, one named Ning (宁) rang me up at the cabaret
and instructed me to obtain permission from the manager and
proceed at once to the Dong Shing Lur Restaurant, Foochow
Road, as he was giving a party.

This person named Ning was not known to me until
I joined the Tu Zeng Dance Hall about one month ago.
Since then he has been dancing with me; I do not know his
name, nor his occupation or address.

On receiving the telephone message, I then
obtained permission from the management and went to the
Dong Shing Lur Restaurant, Foochow Road. On arrival at
the General Hall, 1st floor, of the Restaurant, I recognized
the man named Ning who was sitting at a round table with
about 10 persons. I also saw Ning talking with persons
at another round table. Except Ning, I did not know any
of those attending, but I knew that several of them were
Japanese.

I could not gather anything from the conversation
from the persons round the table.

I was sitting beside Ning, with my back towards the
door of the hall leading to the aisle.

Suddenly I heard a loud report and then saw
everybody standing up and running away. I also stood
page_data.zh:
张莉莉 (張莉莉)
上海                                        J.S. Museum.
老闸捕房           1938年6月18日                     C.D.I. 第九队 谢良

我叫张莉莉，19岁，上海人。我住在成都路同春里34号。我是蒙马兰路都城舞厅的舞女。6月18日晚上9点，一个叫宁 (宁) 的人在歌舞厅给我打电话，指示我向经理请假，立即前往福州路的同兴楼餐厅，因为他正在举办聚会。

这个叫宁的人，我是在大约一个月前加入都城舞厅后才认识的。从那以后他一直和我跳舞；我不知道他的名字，也不知道他的职业或地址。

接到电话后，我向管理层请假，前往福州路的同兴楼餐厅。到达餐厅一楼大厅后，我认出了叫宁的那个人，他正和大约10个人坐在一张圆桌旁。我还看见宁在和另一张圆桌旁的人交谈。除了宁，我不认识任何在场的人，但我知道其中有几个是日本人。

我从圆桌旁人们的谈话中听不出什么名堂。

我坐在宁的旁边，背对着通往过道的大厅门。

突然我听到一声巨响，然后看见大家都站起来逃跑。我也站

page_data.en:
- 2 -

up and ran towards the verandah. I did not see any
person, and I could not say how many shots were fired.
I hid myself behind the door, and returned to the hall
when I saw others do so. On entering the hall, I saw
Ning lying on the ground, and I was so frightened that I
went to the corridor.

〔此处转录不清〕
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

起来向阳台跑去。我没有看见任何人，我也说不出开了多少枪。我躲在门后，看见其他人也这样做时便回到了大厅。进入大厅后，我看见宁躺在地上，我非常害怕，便走到了走廊。

〔此处转录不清〕

page_data.en:
Zuiko Yoki (法城瑞光)
Japanese -- J.D.S. Kobayashi
Louza Station 18-5-38 translated
------- J.D.S. Kobayashi.

My name is Zuiko Yoki, Japanese, Military Buddhist
Priest, now residing at Honkokuji Temple, Chapoo Road.
At about 9.05.p.m. on the 18-5-38, I attended a dinner
party given by Mr. Nin, Pao An (任保安), at the Dong Shing
Lur (同兴楼) Restaurant. The dinner party commenced at
7.p.m. but owing to business I was delayed. When I entered
the room I found the party was almost finished.
At about 9.35.p.m. one Japanese guest left the room
and two or three Chinese including Mr. Ning escorted the
Japanese down stairs and returned to their seats again.
I had ordered my motor car and was waiting in the
room talking to Mr. Yu Ming Toh (余明道) and others at the
table. At about 9.50.p.m., it was 5 or 6 minutes, after the
Chinese returned to their seats, suddenly I heard a report
something like the firing of crackers behind me near the
entrance. At the same time, Mr. Ning who was sitting at the
right side of the table fell on the floor under the chair.
I then looked back and I noticed white smoke crowding at the
entrance. I was pulled away by Mr. Yu (余) as there was
danger. I ran to the balcony of the room.
When I looked into the room again I noticed one
female bleeding from the leg and the blood stained clothing
worn by Mr. Ning was lying on the floor.
At my table I was introduced to three Japanese
namely Mr. Nakajima (中岛洁之) attached to the Japanese Home
Affair Department, Metropolis Planning Section of Planning
Department and Mr. Sakurai (樱井英记), Engineer attached to
page_data.zh:
瑞光由纪 (法城瑞光)
日本人 -- J.D.S. Kobayashi
老闸捕房 1938年5月18日 译
------- J.D.S. Kobayashi.

我叫瑞光由纪，日本人，随军佛教僧侣，现住在乍浦路本国寺。
1938年5月18日晚上9点05分左右，我参加了任保安先生在同济楼餐厅举办的晚宴。晚宴于晚上7点开始，但由于公务我迟到了。当我进入房间时，发现聚会已接近尾声。
晚上9点35分左右，一名日本客人离开房间，包括宁先生在内的两三名中国人护送该日本人下楼，然后又回到座位上。
我已经叫了我的汽车，正在房间里等待，并与余明道 (余明道) 及桌上的其他人交谈。晚上9点50分左右，也就是中国人回到座位后5或6分钟，我突然听到身后靠近入口处传来类似放鞭炮的声音。与此同时，坐在桌子右侧的宁先生倒在椅子下的地板上。我随即回头看，注意到入口处弥漫着白烟。由于有危险，余先生把我拉开。我跑到了房间的阳台。
当我再次看向房间时，我注意到一名女子腿部流血，宁先生穿的血迹斑斑的衣服躺在地板上。
在我的桌子上，有人向我介绍了三名日本人，分别是隶属于日本内务省规划局都市规划课的中岛洁之 (中岛洁之) 先生，以及隶属于

page_data.en:
the Japanese Home Affairs Department attached to the Japanese
Military. Other Japanese sat at the other table I do not know
because they were not introduced.
At the time of shooting a bullet passed the right
right side of my cheek.
In the party one named Yue Nee Fung (俞尼風) and Mr.
Ning Pao An, members of the Teh Tao Government were present,
they being my friends.
The above is my true statement.

Signed: Zuiko Yeki.

〔此处转录不清〕
page_data.zh:
日本内务省并附属于日军的工程师樱井英记 (樱井英记) 先生。其他日本人坐在另一张桌子，我不认识，因为没有介绍。
枪击发生时，一颗子弹擦过我的右脸颊右侧。
聚会上还有特道政府成员俞尼風 (俞尼風) 和任保安先生，他们是我的朋友。
以上是我的真实陈述。

签名：瑞光由纪。

〔此处转录不清〕

Dear Sir, 

This ia to certify that Prisoner Zau Tseu Sung 
admitted to the Hospital on the 19th instant is suffer- 
ing from bullet wounds of the right arm, chest and left 
wrist. There are four wounds of the arm witn the 
underlying bone fractured. These were caused by two 
shots. Tne two wounds of the right side of the 
chest are superficial and connected by a track which 
is in direct slignment with one of the tracks of the 
arm and therefore appear to be produced by the same 
missile. The wounds of the wrist are superficial 
and could have been caused by one of the bullets that 
wounded the arm, 

Prom the foregoing I am of the opinion that 
the wounds though numerous (eight) were the result of 
at most three bullets (probably two). I have also 
examined the garment brought here on the 22nd. The 
position of the holes and blood stains correspond 
exactly with the position of the wunds, 


Yours faithfully 


Scd 3: J.J. Kwoeh.
